Add the reserved veggies to the pan, and then add the oranges and stevia. Add the water to deglaze the pan. Cover and reduce the heat to a gentle simmer. Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the veggies are cooked but are still lightly firm. Add the chilies, for the last 5 minutes of cooking.

title: Chicken Jalfrezi
Recipe Ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. chicken breast portions"1 tsp. cumin seed"1 onion, finely chopped"1 green pepper, seeded and finely chopped"1 red pepper, seeded and finely chopped"1 garlic clove, crushed"2 ¾ inch piece fresh root ginger, finely chopped"1 Tbsp. curry paste"1/4 tsp. chili powder"1 tsp. ground coriander"1 tsp. ground cumin"1/2 tsp. salt"1 4 oz. can chopped tomatoes"2 Tbsp. chopped fresh coriander (cilantro), plus extra to garnish
Body: Skin the chicken breast portions and remove any visible fat. Cut the meat into 1-inch cubes. Heat the oil in a wok, or heavy pan and fry the cumin seeds for 2 minutes until they splutter. Add the onion, peppers, garlic and ginger and fry 6-8 minutes. Add the curry paste and fry for about 2 minutes. Stir in the chili powder, ground coriander, cumin and salt and add 1 t water: fry for 6-8 minutes. Add the chicken cubes and fry for about 5 minutes. Add the canned tomatoes and chopped fresh coriander. Cover the pan tightly with a lid and cook for about 15 minutes or until the chicken cubes are tender. Garnish with sprigs of fresh coriander.

title: Ground Chicken/Turkey Kofta Kebabs
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. ground chicken or turkey"1/4 cup onion, grated"2 Tbsp. red peppers, grated"2 Tbsp. parsley"1 Tbsp. ground coriander"1 tsp. ground cumin"1/4 tsp. ground cinnamon"1/4 tsp. cayenne pepper"1/4 tsp. ground ginger"1/4 tsp. ground black pepper"1 pinch salt"1 pinch ground cloves"1 pinch nutmeg
Body: Mince garlic. Shred onion and pepper. Mix all ingredients together with a spoon until evenly mixed. You can put in the refrigerator from 30 to 24 hours. Use water on hands and form on skewers. Cook them on preheated lightly oiled grill, pan, broil, turning every 2 minutes until completely cooked 6-10 minutes.

title: Bhindi (Okra) Bhajee
Recipe Ingredients: 8 oz. Bhindi (Okra)"4 ripe tomatoes"Half medium onion-very finely chopped"Fresh red chilies-deseeded and veined-then chopped. The quantity is up to you"1/2 tsp. turmeric"1/2 tsp. garam masala"Salt to taste

title: Braised Cabbage and Beets
Recipe Ingredients: Shred 1 onion"1/2 red cabbage"Chop 4 cooked beets"1/2 c. celery stock"1/2 c. balsamic vinegar
Body: Sauté onions and cabbage in stock until tender (may pre boil cabbage if desired). Add chopped beets, vinegar and salt and pepper. Simmer gently for 20-30 minutes until all veggies are very tender. Serve hot.

title: Beet and Orange Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 bag champêtre diced beets"1 1/2 oranges"1 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1 Tbsp. Dijon mustard"3 Tbsp. stock"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Juice the half orange. Pour juice, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper into a salad bowl. While whisking, gradually add in stock. Add beets and mix until well coated in dressing. Slice off peel and pith from other orange, then cut into sections. Gently add orange sections to salad. Garnish with parsley.

title: Beef and Kale Stir Fry
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. flank steak, sliced"1/2 onion, grated"2 cloves garlic, chopped"1/4 tsp. crushed red pepper"7 cups stemmed, quartered kale"1/4 tsp. stevia"2 Tbsp. oyster sauce"1 Tbsp. soy sauce"1 8 oz. can sliced water chestnuts
Body: Toss beef with ¼ tsp. salt. Brown beef; add onion, garlic and red pepper; cook for 30 seconds; reserve. Reduce heat; add kale, stevia and ¼ tsp. salt. Add 1 cup water and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in ¼ cup water, oyster sauce, soy sauce, water chestnuts and beef; warm through

title: Spicy BBQ Sauce and Marinade
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 2 12 oz. jars of salsa (less than 1-gram sugar per serving)"3/4 c. lemon juice"2 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce"5 tsp. stevia"2 tsp. salt"4 tsp. chili powder"½ tsp. Tabasco sauce to taste"Garlic powder to taste
Body: Combine and refrigerate. Makes 24 servings

title: No Sugar Strawberry Jam
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 c. cold water"4 tsp. stevia
Body: In a large saucepan, crush strawberries. Add water and stevia, mixing well. Over medium heat, bring mixture to boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes. Pour into jars, allow to cool and then cover.

title: Strawberry Balsamic Syrup
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"2 Tbsp. water"1 tsp. balsamic vinegar"3 tsp. stevia
Body: In microwave safe bowl, combine all ingredients and toss. Microwave for 2-3 minutes until berries soften.

title: Cocktail Sauce
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 1 c. sugar free ketchup (Simple Girl Brand)"3 Tbsp. horseradish sauce (or to taste)
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Vinaigrette Dressing
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 1/4 c. apple cider vinegar"1/2 c. water"1/2 tsp. thyme"1/2 tsp. onion powder"Ground pepper to taste"3 tsp. stevia"Garlic powder to taste"Oregano to taste
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Fresh Salsa
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 4-5 tomatoes"4 Tbsp. lemon juice"3-4 Tbsp. garlic, minced"1/2 onion, chopped"1 tsp. finely chopped jalapeno or serrano pepper"1/2 tsp. chili powder"1/2 tsp. Italian seasoning"Cayenne pepper to taste"Cilantro (fresh or dried) to taste"Salt and pepper
Body: Put all the ingredients in the food processor. Blend to desired consistency. Refrigerate to blend the flavors. The longer it sits the more flavors it will have. Make pico de gallo by rough chopping all ingredients and skipping the blender.

title: Dill Dressing
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 5 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"2 Tbsp. water"2 Tbsp. dried basil"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. dry mustard"1 tsp. onion powder"2 Tbsp. dried dill
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Vinaigrette
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1 Tbsp. lemon juice"Pinch of salt"Pinch of cayenne (optional)"Fresh ground black pepper to taste"Stevia to taste
Body: Combine all ingredients in food processor. Puree until smooth. Great over spinach salad garnished with fresh sliced strawberries.

title: Balsamic Vinaigrette
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 1/4 c. balsamic vinegar"2 Tbsp. water"2 Tbsp. dried thyme"2 Tbsp. basil"1/4 tsp. garlic powder"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Add all ingredients in a blender and mix well.

title: Smoky BBQ Sauce
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 2 Tbsp. sugar-free tomato sauce"1/2 tsp. dried minced onion"1/2 tsp. apple cider vinegar"1/4 tsp. sugar free liquid smoke"1/4 tsp. paprika"1/4 tsp. chili powder"Pinch of cinnamon"Pinch of cloves"Stevia if needed
Body: In small nonstick saucepan, combine all ingredients and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Gravy
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 1/2 c. homemade chicken broth"1 Grissini or 1 Melba toast ground to a powder in the food processor or blender
Body: Add ¼ c. broth to small saucepan and bring to a boil. Add powdered grissini/melba toast powder to the pan, whisking constantly until dissolved. Still whisking, add remaining ¼ c. broth. Reduce heat to medium and whisk for 3-4 minutes until thickened. Season to taste.

title: Taco Seasoning
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Tbsp. chili powder"2 tsp. onion powder"1 tsp. ground cumin"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. adobo powder"1 tsp. paprika

title: Oil free Salad Dressing
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 1/2 c. unfiltered apple cider vinegar"1/4 c. lemon juice"1 Tbsp. water"Plain or lemon or orange flavored stevia
Body: Flavor it up with any of the following seasonings: salt and pepper, dried shallots, garlic powder, onion powder, chives, dried cilantro, parsley, dry mustard, basil, stevia (plain or lemon or orange flavored)

title: Favorite Shrimp/Scallops/Tilapia Ceviche
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. shrimp/Scallops/Tilapia, fresh or frozen, raw or cooked, peeled"Juice of 1 large lemon"Juice of 1 large lime"1 mild pepper, ribs and seeds removed, finely chopped"1/2 red onion chopped"1 large tomatoes chopped"1 cucumber, peeled and diced into ½ inch pieces"1/4 c. fresh cilantro chopped"1/4 c. fresh parsley, chopped"Sea salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
Body:
Thaw shrimp if frozen. If using raw shrimp, bring a pot of water to a boil and cook shrimp for 1-2 minutes until it turns opaque. Do not overcook the shrimp as it will become rubbery. Rinse shrimp under cold water.

If using scallops, thaw but do not cook prior to using.

If using tilapia, thaw but do not cook prior to using.

For a delicious recipe, combine all three shrimp, tilapia, and scallops. Using a total of 4 ounces when combined.

Combine juice of lemons and limes in a large glass bowl or large Ziploc bag and add shrimp. Cover bowl or seal bag and refrigerate for 30 minutes to marinate. Large shrimp could be cut into smaller chunks to speed up marinating process. To shrimp, onion and pepper, and mix evenly. Refrigerate 30 additional minutes so the flavors infuse the shrimp. Before serving, place shrimp mixture in a bowl and toss with cilantro, tomatoes, parsley, and cucumbers. If needed, add sea salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Lemon Zest Crab Cakes
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. crab"1 garlic clove, minced"1 Tbsp. onion powder"1 tsp. old bay seasoning"1/2 tsp. lemon zest"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. pepper"1 tsp. dry mustard"1 Tbsp. parsley"1 tsp. lemon zest
Body: Heat a sauté pan to medium heat. Mix ingredients together and make 2 small patties. Place in pan and cook until brown on each side. Serve with a side of lemon wedge.

title: Lemon Dill Fish
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. white fish"1 Tbsp. minced onion"2 Tbsp. lemon juice"1 sprig of dill"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Place fish and all ingredients into a foil packet top with lemon and dill and wrap and seal the foil into a packet. Place on the BBQ or in oven at 350 degrees. Cook fish for 5-10 minutes or until fish is thoroughly cooked. Serve with lemon.

title: Chilean Sea Bass
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. sea bass filets"1/2 lemon"1/2 tsp. salt"1/2 tsp lemon pepper"1/2 tsp. chopped dill"2 Tbsp. finely chopped cilantro"1/2 tsp. paprika
Body: Wrap fish and all ingredients in a foil packet and bake at 405 for 20 minutes.

title: Easy Lemon pepper Tilapia
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. tilapia filet"Lemon pepper seasoning"Lemon, thinly sliced"Salt to taste
Body: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray baking sheet with spray oil. Place tilapia filets on cookie sheet and season with salt, pepper and lemon pepper seasoning. Top with two lemon slices. Bake in oven for 15 minutes or until fish is easily flaked with fork.

title: Sautéed Scallops
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. scallops"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. pepper"1 lemon
Body: Spray a nonstick frying pan with spray oil and place scallops or shrimp in pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Simmer by covering with lid for 10 minutes. Sauté until cooked through and both sides are evenly browned. Substitute shrimp but cook only until pink on both sides

title: Fried Chicken Nuggets
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken chopped into nugget sized pieces"1 grissini bread stick or 4 Melba toast snacks"Salt and pepper to taste"1/2 tsp. paprika"1/4 tsp. ground red pepper"1/2 tsp. garlic powder
Body: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice chicken breast into 3 tenders. Grind breadstick in food processor until it is a powder. Put grissini powder in a separate bowl and mix in seasonings. Spray chicken with a small amount of spray oil then dredge in grissini powder and seasonings. Place chicken in baking dish and bake 30-40 minutes, turning over halfway through. During the last 5 minutes, turn on broiler and broil 2-3 minutes each side. Optionally place in air fryer oven and press the chicken setting.

title: Chicken Taco Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 2 c. shredded iceberg lettuce"4 oz. ground chicken or turkey"1/2 tsp. garlic salt"1/4 tsp. chili seasonings"1/4 tsp. ground cumin"1/4 tsp. adobo seasoning"Crumbled Melba toast
Body: Sauté ground chicken and spices. Arrange lettuce and place chicken on top of lettuce and top with Melba toast.

title: Cornish Game Hens
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. Cornish game hen"1 c. diced onions"1/2 tsp. poultry seasoning"1/2 tsp. old bay seasoning"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Put seasoning on birds Arrange onions in roasting pan. Place bird, breast side up, on onions. Roast in 375-degree oven for 55 to 65 minutes or until tender, basting with juices as needed. Make sure hens are thoroughly cooked.

title: Grilled Chicken or Turkey burger
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground chicken or turkey breast"1/4 tsp. pepper"1/4 tsp. onion powder"1 tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. dry mustard"Salt to taste"Montreal steak seasoning to taste
Body: Add all the ingredients to the ground chicken breast, Make into a small patty. Grill or broil.

title: Egg Roll
Recipe Ingredients: 2-3 big cabbage leaves"1 c. shredded cabbage"1/8 tsp. onion salt"1/8 tsp. garlic powder"1/8 tsp. Chinese Five Spice"1/2 packet stevia"2 Sesame flavored Melba Toast rounds"4 oz. cooked chopped chicken or shrimp
Body: Steam big cabbage leaves & shredded cabbage 5 minutes. Add all ingredients together. Mix and then wrap in big cabbage leaves. Garnish with Melba rounds. Feel free to add as much shredded cabbage is desired. Its FREE!

title: Blackened Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless chicken breast"1/4 tsp. paprika"1/4 tsp. cayenne pepper"1/4 tsp. ground cumin"1/4 tsp. garlic powder"1/4 tsp. onion powder"1/4 tsp. dried thyme"Pinch of ground white pepper"Salt to taste
Body: Heat a skillet over high heat for 5 minutes until hot. Mix seasonings and coat the chicken breasts evenly with the spice mixture. Spray hot pan with a small amount of cooking spray oil. Place the chicken in the hot pan and cook for 1 minute. Turn, and cook 1 minute on other side. Reduce heat to low and cover chicken. Cook for about 5-10 minutes over low until cooked thoroughly.

title: Curry Chicken and Baby Spinach
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless skinless chicken breast"2 c. baby spinach"2 tsp. onion powder"1 tsp. garlic powder"1/2 c. chicken broth"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. pepper"Juice of 1 lime"1/2 Tbsp. curry powder
Body: Heat a pan on stovetop over medium heat. Mix half the lime juice an all the seasonings and coat chicken. Cook the chicken through. Add spinach for 1 minute and serve in a bowl. Just prior to serving, squeeze the other ½ the lime juice over mixture.

title: Lemon Roasted Chicken and Veggies
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken breasts, chopped"1/2 c. bell peppers, chopped"1/4 onion chopped"1/2 zucchini, chopped"1/2 c. Brussel sprouts chopped"1/2 c. broccoli florets"1/2 c. cauliflower florets"1/4 c. tomatoes, chopped"2 Tbsp. Lemon juice"1/2 tsp. pink salt"1/2 tsp. black pepper"1/2 tsp. Italian seasoning"1/4 tsp. paprika (optional)
Body: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Chop all veggies into large pieces and the chicken into cubes. Place the chicken and vegetables in a medium roasting pan. Add the lemon juice, salt, and pepper, Italian seasoning, and paprika. Toss to combine. Bake for 15 minutes or until the veggies are charred and chicken is cooked thoroughly.

title: Sautéed Lemon Basil Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless chicken breast, cooked and cubed"1/4 c. finely chopped onion"1 clove garlic, chopped"2 1/2 c. chopped tomatoes"1/4 c. chopped fresh basil"Juice of half a lemon"1/2 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. paprika"Stevia to taste
Body: Heat skillet to medium heat. Sauté the onions and garlic. Stir in the tomatoes, chicken, basil, salt and hot pepper and paprika. Reduce heat to medium, and cover skillet for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently until mixture is hot, and tomatoes are soft. Add stevia to taste.

title: Easy Crockpot Salsa Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. skinless boneless chicken breasts"1/2 c. salsa (no added sugar)
Body: Add chicken breasts to salsa to crock pot and cook on low for 4-6 hours

title: Apple Chicken Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken, cooked and diced"1 apple chopped"3 stalks celery, diced"2 Tbsp. lemon juice"1  Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"Pinch of cinnamon"Pinch of nutmeg"Pinch of cardamom"Pinch of salt"Stevia to taste"Lemon wedge
Body: Mix ingredients together; sprinkle with stevia and cinnamon. Chill for 30 minutes before serving. Splash with lemon juice from lemon wedge just before serving.

title: Turkey Sausage Spinach
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground turkey"1 (10 oz.) box frozen chopped spinach or 4 oz fresh spinach"1/2 c. water"1/4 tsp. garlic powder"1/4 tsp. onion powder"1/2 tsp. sage"1/4 tsp. thyme"1/4 tsp. fennel"¼ tsp. dill"Pinch of nutmeg"Pinch of cayenne"Pink Himalayan salt and pepper to taste"1/4 tsp. stevia
Body: Cook turkey thoroughly in a skillet until beginning to brown. Remove from pan and set aside. Add water to skillet and bring to a boil. Add spinach to skillet then cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes or until water is almost gone. Stir in al spices, stevia, and turkey and cook another 5 minutes

title: Mexican Taco Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 2 c. shredded iceberg lettuce"4 oz. lean ground beef/sirloin/buffalo"1/2 tsp. garlic salt"1/4 tsp. chili seasonings"crumbled melba toast
Body: Sauté ground beef and spices. Sprinkle on top of lettuce and top with crumbled melba toast.

title: Savory Beef Sausage
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground beef"1 tsp. paprika"1 tsp. sage"1/2 tsp. garlic powder"1/4 tsp. ground fennel"1/2 tsp. pepper"1/4 tsp. pink Himalayan salt"Pinch of red pepper flakes or cayenne pepper (Optional)
Body: Mix spices together in a large bowl. Add raw meat and mix thoroughly. Form into patty. Brown meat on stovetop until cooked through.

title: Meatloaf
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean ground beef/sirloin/buffalo"1/4 Tbsp. onion powder"1 tsp. garlic powder"1/4 tsp. sage"1/4 tsp. oregano"1/4 tsp. basil"1/4 tsp. salt"Pepper to taste"One small chopped roma tomato"1/4 chopped green onion
Body: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine all ingredients in bowl, mixing gently. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes or until done

title: Bok Choy Stir Fry
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean ground beef"1 tsp. coconut aminos (any flavor)"3/4 tsp. ginger"1 tsp. of water or coconut aminos"3 Tbsp. of diced red onion"1 head of chopped bok choy
Body: Whisk together coconut aminos and ginger and set aside. In a large sauté pan, heat water and/or coconut aminos. Add onion, carrots and bok choy, cook until the onions are translucent and the bok choy is wilted. Transfer to a plate and set aside. In the same skillet cook the ground beef until browned. Add the vegetables back into the pan. Pour the stir fry sauce over top and toss.

title: Famous Chili
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean ground sirloin beef"1 c. chopped tomatoes"1/2 c. water"2 Tbsp. minced onion"1/2 cup chopped green or red bell peppers"2 cloves garlic, crushed and minced"Pinch of onion powder"1/4 tsp. chili powder"pinch of oregano"Cayenne pepper, to taste"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Brown ground beef. Add onions and peppers and garlic and sauté until softened. Stir in tomatoes and water. Add spices and simmer slowly. Salt and pepper to taste. The longer it cooks the more flavorful it becomes. Add water as needed.

title: Balsamic Mustard-Crusted Steak
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean steak (filet, sirloin, London broil)"1 Tbsp. mustard powder"2 Tbsp. balsamic vinegar"1/4 tsp. salt"1/2 tsp. freshly ground black pepper"1 Tbsp. garlic powder
Body: Line a broiler pan with foil and place steak on top. Mix all seasonings in a mixing bowl. Coat the steak evenly with mustard mixture and let stand 10 minutes. Place on broiler pan and broil steak to desired temperature. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Wilted Baby Spinach Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. fresh baby spinach"1/4 med. red onion sliced"1/4 c. Apple cider vinegar"1/2 tsp. mustard powder"1/4 tsp. garlic powder"1/4 tsp. onion powder"Stevia to taste"Pepper to taste
Body: Toss spinach and onion together in bowl. Cover and chill in refrigerator. For dressing, add ingredients and heat the dressing until it starts to steam. Pour hot dressing over salad tossing gently to wilt greens.

title: Sautéed Cabbage
Recipe Ingredients: 1/2 small head cabbage"2 Tbsp. water"Juice of half lemon or 1 Tbsp. balsamic vinegar"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Place cabbage in skillet and sauté adding water a little at a time as needed to soften cabbage. Cover and steam for 5 to 10 minutes, until slightly tender. Add lemon juice or balsamic vinegar. Salt and pepper to taste. Place cabbage in a bowl and serve

title: Cucumber Onion Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced"2 Tbsp. thinly sliced white onion"2 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley or dill"2 Tbsp. white vinegar"2 tsp. soy sauce"Optional stevia to taste
Body: Combine ingredients and chill for 30-60 minutes

title: Crisp Radish Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. radishes, sliced"Juice from one lemon"1 Tbsp, dried minced onion"1 Tbsp. parsley"1/2 tsp. dill"1/2 tsp. celery seed"Salt and Pepper to taste
Body: In bowl, combine all ingredients and refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.

title: Asparagus Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1/4 tsp. dill"1/4 tsp. mustard powder"1/4 tsp. onion powder"1/4 tsp. stevia"Salt and pepper to taste"4 oz. fresh asparagus"3 green onions, cut into ½ inch pieces
Body: Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl; set aside. Clean and snap off woody ends of asparagus and discard the woody ends. Cut stalks into ¼ inch slices. Place in a large salad bowl. Pour dressing over top; toss gently to coat. Cover and chill 1 hour before serving. Just before serving, finish with green onions to taste.

title: Roasted/Grilled Lemon Pepper Asparagus
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. asparagus"Lemon pepper seasoning"Himalayan salt to taste
Body: Clean and snap off woody ends of asparagus spears and discard. Place asparagus on baking sheet, grill, or air fryer oven. Sprinkle with salt and lemon-pepper seasoning. Cook until tender (10-15 minutes air fryer at 400 degrees) (15-20 minutes in oven at 350 degrees) (10-15 minutes on open grill until softened)

title: Lemon Swiss Chard
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. roughly chopped Swiss chard"1 small garlic clove"2 Tbsp. water"Juice from one lemon"Himalayan salt and pepper to taste
Body: Put 1 Tbsp. water in nonstick pan and sauté garlic until tender; set aside. Pour another 1 Tbsp. water into same pan and add Swiss chard. Add salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat for 5-6 minutes, tossing occasionally while cooking. When greens have softened, transfer to a serving bowl. Splash with lemon juice just before serving

title: Zucchini Basil Pasta Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. zucchini"1 Tbsp. minced garlic"1 medium tomato chopped"1/2 cup basil leaves, torn into pieces"2 tsp. cold water"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Spiralize the zucchini and set aside. Add garlic to a skillet. On medium heat, add zucchini noodles. Sauté and toss the noodles with tongs and cook until slightly firm. Do not overcook. Stir in the tomatoes and basil cooking for another two minutes.. Toss some fresh chopped basil to finish just before serving.

title: Greens
Recipe Ingredients: 2 Tbsp. chicken bouillon base"4 oz. chopped greens any type"Pinch of onion salt"Salt and pepper to taste"Red pepper flakes to taste"Splash of Apple Cider Vinegar
Body: Heat bouillon base, on medium heat, just prior to boiling. Reduce heat. Add greens and sauté a few minutes until soft. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, onion powder, and red pepper flakes to taste. Finish with a splash of apple cider vinegar just prior to serving.

title: Garden Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1/4 head crisp iceberg lettuce or Boston lettuce"6 spinach leaves or mixed baby greens"3 thin, shredded slices radicchio"1/4 red pepper, sliced"1 small tomato chopped"1 green onion, chopped"Pinch of dill weed, chopped"Fresh chopped parsley to taste
Body: Place ingredients in bowl and toss.

title: Apple Cider Vinegar Strawberry Spinach Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. baby spinach (mixed baby greens or lettuce)"3/4 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1/2 Tbsp. Dijon mustard"1/2 tsp. Orange zest"1/2 Tbsp. orange juice (from squeezed orange)"1/2 tsp. freshly grated ginger"Salt and Pepper to taste"2 oz thinly sliced strawberries
Body: Whisk ingredients except spinach and strawberries together and toss with baby spinach or mixed baby greens or any type of lettuce. Serve with thinly sliced strawberries.

title: Veggie Tossed Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 large head lettuce"1 chopped green pepper"1 chopped red onion"1 chopped bundle parsley"1 chopped bundle celery"4 oz. radishes"1 chopped medium cucumber"1 handful fresh mushrooms
Body: Toss chopped ingredients in salad bowl. Chill and serve with balsamic vinaigrette dressing (see recipe).

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 6 oz. chicken broth base (see recipe)"4 oz. cooked, chopped chicken"2 stalks of chopped celery"2 oz. chopped carrots"½ sweet onion chopped"2 cups chopped cabbage (add towards end)
Body: Combine, bring to a boil. Lower heat & simmer for 20 min. Use cooked rotisserie chicken from store to save time.

title: French Onion Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Vidalia onion"1 c. beef broth"1 tsp. garlic power"1 tsp. pepper"2 pieces of melba toast
Body: Slice onion into wedges using an apple slicer to open the onion. Place in a baking dish. Season the onion and add ¼ c. beef broth and Place in a baking dish. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Make sure the onion is a little firm. Serve in a bowl with beef broth and Melba toast.

title: Chicken Broth Base
Recipe Ingredients: 6-4 oz. pieces of chicken"9 c. water"1 tsp. garlic power"1 tsp. onion powder"1 Tbsp. Old Bay Seasoning"1 tsp. poultry seasoning"1 tsp. pepper"1 Tbsp. sea salt
Body: Combine ingredients in stock pot and cook until chicken is done, about 45 minutes. Take chicken out and save for other meals. Use broth for soups, and in other recipes. Freeze some of the broth in ice cube trays for sautéing later.

title: Sour Apple Tossed Salad
Recipe Ingredients: ½ head lettuce"1 unpeeled chopped tart apple"½ small red onion, sliced into rings"1 peeled and chopped cucumber
Body: In a large salad bowl, toss lettuce, apple slices, cucumber and onions.

title: Berry Smoothie
Recipe Ingredients: 1 chopped apple"1 sliced cucumber"2 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"2 Tbsp. water"Juice of one lemon"Garlic salt"Salt and Pepper to taste"Stevia to taste
Body: Chop apple and thinly slice cucumber. Combine vinegar, water and lemon juice. Season with garlic salt, pepper and stevia to taste.

title: No Sugar Baked Apple
Recipe Ingredients: 1 apple, peeled"½ tsp. ground cinnamon"Dash of ground clove"1 tsp. stevia
Body: Bake an apple and peel off skin and mash. Add cinnamon, clove and stevia and serve.

title: Cinnamon Strawberries
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 Tbsp. cinnamon"1 tsp. stevia"1 Tbsp. lemon juice
Body: Squeeze lemon juice over sliced strawberries. Mix cinnamon and Stevia and sprinkle over the strawberries

title: Southern Broccoli Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 3 cups broccoli florets"¼ cup finely chopped onion"¾ cups chopped celery"1/3 cup low fat shredded cheddar cheese"¼ cup light mayo"¼ cup nonfat plain yogurt"2 Tbsp. honey"1/8 tsp. black pepper
Body: In a medium bowl, combine broccoli, onion, celery, and cheese. Set aside. In a small bowl, combine remaining ingredients. Add mayo mixture to veggie mixture and toss. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours to “marry” the flavors

title: Five Spice Kale Chips
Recipe Ingredients: 1 kale bunch (stems and rough ribs removed)"1 Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil"¼ tsp. Chinese five spice"1/8 tsp. salt
Body: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees. Add the kale to a large bowl and toss well with the oil, five spice powder and salt. Arrange the leaves in a single layer on o 2 large baking sheets. Bake until the leaves are crisp about 20 minutes. Transfer the sheets to racks to cool, and then serve.

title: Grilled Seafood and Quinoa Salad
Recipe Ingredients: ¼ tsp. cayenne pepper"1 cup quinoa, dried, rinsed well"½ lb. medium shrimp, peeled and de-veined"½ lb. scallops"½ cup cooked black beans or edamame"1 jalapeno pepper, stemmed and finely chopped"½ red bell pepper, chopped"1 plum tomato, seeded and chopped"2 small scallions, chopped"1 mango, chopped"1 avocado, chopped"2 Tbsp. cilantro leaves, chopped"2 Tbsp. fresh lime juice"2 Tbsp. fresh lime juice"1 tsp. honey"1 Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil"Sea salt to taste
Body: Combine all citrus dressing ingredients well in a small mixing bowl. Cool the quinoa according to directions in water. Fluff quinoa with a fork. If any liquid remains, continue simmering until absorbed. Let the quinoa cool completely. Toss shrimp and scallops with the olive oil in a bowl. Heat grill pan or sauté pan over medium high heat. Add the shrimp and scallops and sear until pink and just cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Remove from the pan and let cool. Place the cooled quinoa in a large bowl and add the shrimp and scallops, beans, jalapeno, bell pepper, tomato, scallions, mango and avocado. Pour the dressing over the mixture and toss gently to combine. Divide the salad among four plates and scatter cilantro over each.

title: Edamame and Pasta with Feta
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. uncooked whole grain penne or rotini pasta"8 oz. fresh or frozen edamame"8 oz. fresh or frozen edamame"1 ½ cups grape tomatoes"16 kalamata olives, pitted, coarsely chopped"2 Tbsp. chopped fresh basil leaves"½ tsp. rosemary leaves, crumbled"1 medium garlic clove, minced"1/8 t red pepper flakes  "1 medium lemon, halved"2 oz. feta cheese, reduced fat, crumbled
Body: Cook the pasta according to the package directions, omitting salt and adding the edamame during the last 2 minutes of cooking. In a small bowl, combine the tomatoes, olives, basil, rosemary, garlic, and pepper flakes. Toss to blend and set aside. Drain the pasta and edamame in a colander, place on a serving platter or pasta bowl, squeeze lemon overall, top with feta and mound the tomato mixture in the center.

title: Tuna and Veggie Pasta Salad
Recipe Ingredients: ¾ cup dried whole grain pasta         "1 ½ cups low sodium chunk white albacore tuna, drained"¾ cups grape tomatoes, chopped"½ small cucumber, chopped"½ medium bell pepper, chopped"1/3 small sweet onion, chopped"¼ cup light balsamic vinaigrette"¼ cup light mayo"2 Tbsp. chopped fresh cilantro
Body: Prepare the pasta using the package directions, omitting the salt. Transfer to colander. Rinse with cold water to cool completely. Drain well. Transfer to bowl. Gently stir in the remaining ingredients. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.

title: Avocado Tuna Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 ripe medium size avocado"½ cup pico de gallo"2 tuna pouches, in water
Body: Remove the pit from the avocado. Use spoon to remove insides of avocado and place in a medium bowl. Mash avocado with a fork. Add the pico de gallo and mix well. Add the tuna to the bowl and mix well. Serve the tuna salad with your choice of whole wheat crackers, whole wheat pitas or lettuce wraps.

title: Crab Cake Burgers
Recipe Ingredients: ¼ onion, minced           "2 cans lump crab meat, drained"1 egg"1 egg white"½ tsp. hot sauce"¼ tsp. black pepper"1 Tbsp. olive oil"¼ cup light mayo"¼ cup plain Greek yogurt"1 Tbsp. adobo sauce from chipotle peppers"½ cup frozen corn kernels"6 large lettuce leaves"1 ½ cups lettuce, shredded"1 ripe tomato"1 ripe avocado
Body: Coat a small nonstick skillet with cooking spray over medium high heat. Add onion and sauté 2-3 minutes or until onions are clear. Set aside to cool. In a medium bowl combine crabmeat, breadcrumbs, egg, egg white, hot sauce, salt and pepper. Mix well until all ingredients are incorporated. Stir in cooled onion. Add oil and generous amount of cooking spray to a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Form crab mixture to ½ inch thick patties using a heaping ¼ cup. Fry about 4-5 minutes on each side or until golden brown. In a small bowl, whisk together the mayo, yogurt, adobo sauce and corn. Place each crab cake on a lettuce leaf. Place ¼ cup lettuce, 1 tomato slice, and 2 avocado slices on top of each crab cake and top with 2 Tbsp. sauce

title: Shrimp Fajitas
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. medium shrimp, peeled and deveined"1 tsp. canola oil"1 red bell pepper, sliced into thin strips"1 green bell pepper, sliced into thin strips"1 medium onion, sliced into thin strips"¼ cup water"½ Tbsp. chili powder"¼ tsp. cayenne pepper"¼ tsp. cumin"½ tsp. salt"½ tsp. black pepper
Body: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. cook the shrimp over medium heat for about 2 minutes. Remove the shrimp from the pan and set aside. Add the oil to the pan and heat. Add the bell peppers and onions and cook for about 7 minutes. Add the shrimp and any juices back to pan. Add the water and spices, including salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until the water evaporates. Serve the shrimp and peppers in corn tortillas.

title: Cod on Roasted Pepper and White Beans
Recipe Ingredients: ½ t paprika       "¼ tsp. salt"¼ tsp. black pepper"4 cod filets"1 tsp.extra virgin olive oil"¼ cup water"1 can white beans"16 kalamata olives"½ cup roasted red peppers, diced"2 garlic cloves, minced"½ t fresh rosemary, chopped
Body: In a small bowl, combine the paprika, ¼ t of salt and black pepper. Sprinkle both sides of fillets with the paprika mixture. Heat 1 t of oil in a large nonstick pan over medium heat. Cook fillets 4 minutes, turn and cook 3 minutes or until opaque in center. Meanwhile, bring the water to a boil over medium high heat in a medium saucepan. Add the remaining bean ingredients. Cook 1-2 minutes to heat through. Remove from the heat, cover, and let stand while fish is cooking. To serve, place equal amounts of bean mixture in each of shallow soup bowls or rimmed dinner plates and top with fillets

title: Buttery Lemon Grilled Fish on Grilled Asparagus
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. asparagus spears"4 cod filets"1 zest and juice of lemon"¼ cups light butter
Body:
Heat a grill or grill pan over medium high heat. Coat the asparagus with cooking spray and cook 6-8 minutes until tender and crisp. Set aside on a rimmed serving platter and cover to keep warm.

Coat both sides of the fish with cooking spray, sprinkle with ¼ t black pepper, if desired and cook for 3 minutes on each side or until opaque center. Meanwhile, combine the light butter, lemon zest and ¼ t salt in a small bowl. Spoon the butter mixture over the asparagus and spread overall. Top with the fish and squeeze of lemon juice over fish

title: Crunchy Mediterranean Tuna Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 tuna pouch in water"¼ cups light mayo"3 Tbsp. plain nonfat yogurt"¼ cups onion"1 celery stalk, chopped"½ red bell pepper, finely diced"3 Tbsp. Kalamata olives"¼ tsp. black pepper"6 large butter lettuce leaves
Body: In a small bowl, mix the tuna, mayo, yogurt, onion, celery, red pepper, olives and black pepper. Divide the tuna mixture among the lettuce leaves (about ½ cup tuna salad per lettuce leaf). Fold to form a wrap.

title: Grilled Salmon and Avocado Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 frozen salmon filets (4 ounces each, thawed)"1 Tbsp. olive oil"1 T grill seasoning"4 cups romaine lettuce, chopped"½ cups red onion, thinly sliced"1 cup cucumber, thinly sliced"1 ripe avocado, peeled, seeded and sliced"¼ cup lime juice"1 Tbsp. olive oil"1 tsp. Dijon mustard"1 tsp. stevia"¼ tsp. salt"¼ tsp. black pepper
Body:
Preheat indoor or outdoor grill. Pat the thawed salmon filets dry with a paper towel. Brush each side with the olive oil and season with no salt grill seasoning. Grill the salmon filets on each side for 4-5 minutes or until just cooked through. Set aside.

Build each salad starting with 1 cup of romaine lettuce, top with ¼ of the sliced onion, ¼ cup of sliced cucumber, the grilled salmon filet and ¼ of the sliced avocado. Repeat for remaining salads. In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, stevia, salt and pepper. Drizzle over each salad

title: Fish Tacos
Recipe Ingredients: 2 limes, juiced        "1 T canola oil"2 t chili powder"¼ cup fresh cilantro leaves, chopped"1 ¼ lbs. tilapia"8 corn tortillas, heated"½ avocado, smashed"¼ cup Greek plain yogurt, fat free"1 tsp. hot sauce"½ cup pico de gallo"¼ red cabbage, shredded
Body: In a medium bowl, whisk together the oil, lime juice, chili powder and cilantro. Add the fish and marinate in the fridge for 15-20 minutes. Remove the fish from the marinade. Coat a large sauté pan with cooking spray. Sauté the fish over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side. Remove fish from pan and flake with a fork. In a small bowl combine the avocado, yogurt and hot sauce. Evenly divide the fish among 8 tortillas. Top with 1 ½ Tbsp. of avocado mixture. Top each taco with 1 Tbsp. pico de gallo and purple cabbage.

title: Greek Salmon and Veggie Packets
Recipe Ingredients: ¼ cups lemon juice"2 garlic cloves"1 Tbsp. oregano"1 tsp. salt"1 tsp. black pepper"1 zucchini"1 onion"1 red bell pepper"4 salmon filets"2 tsp. olive oil
Body: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Spray four 8 x 8-inch sheets of aluminum foil with cooking spray. Set aside. Combine lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper in a small bowl. set aside. Place ¼ of zucchini, onion, and bell pepper on each sheet of foil. Top each one with a salmon filet. Pour ¼ of lemon juice mixture over each salmon filet. Top with ½ t olive oil. Bring foil sides up on both sides and seal. Place on baking sheet and bake in oven for 20 minutes.

title: Classic Beef Stew
Recipe Ingredients: 2 Tbsp. all-purpose flour or whole wheat pastry flour"1 Tbsp. Italian seasoning"3 Tbsp. olive oil"2 lb. top road (cut into ¾ inch cubes)"1 ½ lbs. cremini mushrooms"4 cups chicken broth, reduced sodium, low fat, divided use)"1 large onion, coarsely chopped           "3 cloves garlic, minced"2 large russet potatoes"3 medium carrots"1 cup frozen peas"1 Tbsp. fresh thyme, minced"1 Tbsp. red wine vinegar"1/2 tsp. freshly ground black pepper
Body:
Combine all-purpose flour with the Italian seasoning. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Dredge the beef cubes lightly in the flour mixture and add the beef in batches to keep the beef in one layer until well browned on each side.

Remove the beef from the pan and deglaze the pan with ¼ cup chicken broth. Add in the mushrooms and sauté for about 4 minutes until well browned. Remove the mushrooms from the pan and deglaze with another ¼ cup of broth. Add the onions and garlic and sauté for 3 minutes. Return the beef to the pot; add the remaining chicken broth, and bring to a boil. Partially cover, lower the heat to simmer and cook for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Peel and cut potatoes into ¾ inch pieces. Cut the carrots in ½ inch pieces. Add the potatoes and carrots to the stew and continue to cook for another 45 minutes or until veggies are tender. Add in the reserved mushrooms, peas and thyme. Season with red wine vinegar and black pepper

title: Slow Cooker Flank Steak Tacos
Recipe Ingredients: 1 ¼ flank steak"2 tsp. chili powder"1 tsp. cumin"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 lime, juiced"½ cup water"12 corn tortillas"¾ cup pico de gallo
Body: Place the flank steak in a slow cooker. Sprinkle the meat with chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder. Pour the lime juice over the steak. Pour in the water. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or until done. Shred the steak with a fork. Scoop about ½ oz. steak into each tortilla. Top each taco with 1 Tbsp. pico de gallo

title: Grilled Steak with Mushrooms
Recipe Ingredients: 2 filet steaks, 4 oz each about 1 ½ inch thick"¼ tsp. black pepper"1 Tbsp. margarine or olive oil"1 package pint mushrooms, sliced"2 medium baked sweet potatoes, not included in nutrition facts
Body: Prepare a grill on high. Spray grill rack with cooking spray. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper. Place steaks on grill with direct high heat and sear on each side for 1-2 minutes per side. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 18-23 minutes or until done. Transfer steak to a plate and cover with foil; let rest for 5 minutes before serving. In medium sauté pan, heat margarine over medium high heat. Add mushrooms and sauté for 5-6 minutes or until tender. Serve with sweet potatoes.

title: Onion Smothered Pork Chops
Recipe Ingredients: 1 tsp. paprika"1 tsp. sage"¼ tsp. salt"¼ tsp. black pepper"2 yellow onions"¼ cup fat free chicken broth"1 Tbsp. Dijon mustard
Body: Sprinkle seasonings over pork. Press mixture so it adheres to pork. Lightly spray a large skillet with cooking spray. heat over medium heat. Cook pork for 4 minutes on each side. Transfer to a plate, set aside. In the same skillet, still over medium heat, cook onions and 1 T broth covered for 5 min stirring often. Cook uncovered, for 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown, stirring halfway through. Stir in remaining 3 T of broth and mustard. Return pork to skillet, placing it on the onions. Cook for 5 min or until the onions are tender. Remove from heat, let stand for 3 minutes. Transfer pork to plates. Spoon the onions over pork

title: Herb Crusted Pork Chops
Recipe Ingredients: 1 tsp. rosemary"1 tsp. oregano"½ tsp. thyme"1 tsp. garlic powder"½ tsp. chili powder"¼ tsp. black pepper"1 Tbsp. olive oil"1 ½ lb. boneless pork chops
Body: In a small bowl, combine rosemary, oregano, thyme, garlic powder, chili powder and black pepper. Mix well. Add olive oil to large sauté pan and heat over medium high heat. Season pork chops on both sides with herb blend. Sauté pork chops for about 5 minutes on each side until done

title: Grilled Pork and Cheese Quesadillas
Recipe Ingredients: 1 tsp. olive oil"½ cup onion, minced"2 tsp. garlic, minced"1 lb. pork loin, ground"8 corn or whole wheat tortillas"1 cup Mexican cheese blend, reduced fat"3 green onions, thinly sliced"1 canned green chilies"½ cup nonfat Greek yogurt"½ cup salt"1 cup tomatoes, diced
Body: Prepare an outdoor grill on medium heat. Add onion and sauté for 3 minutes. Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute. Add pork and sauté for 5-6 minutes. Drain excess fat. On 2 baking sheets, lay out 4 tortillas. Spray top slightly with oil. Flip over. Spread ½ cup of pork evenly over the tortilla. Sprinkle with the cheese, scallions, and chilies. Top all the tortillas with the remaining tortillas to form a quesadilla and press together lightly. Spray with oil. When the grill is hot, place quesadillas on grill for 5-7 min. on each side. You may cover grill to help melt cheese and brown quesadillas. Cut into wedges and serve with yogurt, salsa and tomatoes.

title: Bangers and Mash
Recipe Ingredients: 1 nonstick cooking spray"2 lbs. sweet potatoes, mashed and dried"1 T smart balance buttery spread"½ t salt"¼ t black pepper"1 whole wheat bread, crusts removed"¼ cup egg substitute"20 oz. lean ground turkey         "½ tsp. ground thyme"½ tsp. ground sage"1 tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. cayenne pepper"¼ tsp. black pepper"½ tsp. salt
Body:
Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Bake sweet potatoes for 45 minutes or until tender when pierced with a fork. Set aside and let cool slightly. Mix the whole wheat bread and egg and mix well until bread is softened and forms a paste. Stir in remaining ingredients for the sausage and mix well to incorporate.

Divide sausage mixture in to 6 equal sized patties and sauté in a nonstick sauté pan coated with cooking spray for 4-5 minutes on each side or until cooked thoroughly. Once the sweet potatoes have cooled slightly, peel the skins off and add the peeled sweet potatoes to a bowl with the smart balance, salt, and pepper. Mash with a potato masher until fluffy. Serve sausage patty over mashed sweet potatoes.

title: Mushroom Burger
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. lean ground turkey"½ tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. black pepper"4 whole wheat buns"1 Tbsp. margarine or olive oil"8 oz. sliced mushrooms
Body: Preheat indoor or outdoor grill. In a medium bowl, mix turkey, garlic powder, and black pepper. Divide turkey into four equal portions, shaping into a patty. Place patties on grill rack, grill 3-4 minutes per side or until juice runs clear. In a medium sauté pan, heat margarine over medium heat. Add mushrooms and sauté for 5 minutes until soft. Place each burger on bun, top with mushrooms.

title: Pecan Crusted Turkey Tenderloin with Sweet Potatoes
Recipe Ingredients: 1 nonstick cooking spray  ·          "1 egg"2 egg whites"1 tsp. garlic powder"½ tsp. black pepper"2 oz. pecan chips"24 oz. turkey bread tenderloin"2 sweet potatoes (6 oz each, peeled and cut into cubes)"1 Tbsp. olive oil"½ tsp. ground cinnamon"2 Tbsp. Splenda/brown sugar blend
Body: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Sprat large baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. In a medium shallow bowl, whisk together egg and egg whites. In another medium shallow bowl combine garlic powder, pepper and pecans. Dip turkey breast tenderloin in egg mixture and coat well. Dredge turkey in a pecan mixture and cover on both sides. Place in a baking dish. Discard leftover egg mixture. In a medium bowl, mix the sweet potatoes, oil, cinnamon and Splenda brown sugar blend. Arrange the sweet potatoes around the turkey breast tenderloin in baking dish. Bake for 50 minutes or until done.

title: Turkey Sloppy Joes
Recipe Ingredients: 2 t canola oil"1 cup chopped onion"1 cup chopped green bell pepper"1 lb. lean ground turkey"1 cup tomato sauce, no salt added"1 tsp. brown sugar"½ cup ketchup"1 tsp. crushed red pepper flakes"2 tsp. red wine vinegar"¼ tsp. black pepper
Body: Heat the oil in a large skillet and sauté the onion and bell pepper until translucent. Add the turkey and cook about 5 minutes. Drain off any fat. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Simmer 15 minutes and serve on buns if desired (not included in nutrition analysis).

title: Turkey Tostada
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. ground turkey"1 Tbsp. chili powder"1 tsp. cumin"¼ tsp. crushed red pepper"2 garlic cloves, minced"½ tsp. salt"½ tsp. black pepper"6 oz. fresh baby spinach"¼ cup fat free chicken broth"6 corn tortillas"6 cups shredded lettuce"¼ cup Mexican style shredded cheese, reduced fat"3 tomatoes, seeded and diced"6 Tbsp. plain Greek yogurt
Body: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Coat baking sheet with cooking spray, set aside. Coat a large sauté pan over high heat. Add turkey and sauté until begging to brown, about 7- 9 minutes. Add chili powder, cumin, red pepper flakes, garlic, salt and black pepper. Sauté an additional 2-3 minutes. Add spinach and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes. Add cheese and thicken broth and stir until cheese is melted. Lay six corn tortillas on prepared baking sheet. Spook the turkey mixture evenly over each tortilla. Bake for 15 minutes or until tortilla is crispy. Top each tostada with 1 cup shredded lettuce, ½ a tomato and 1 Tbsp. Greek yogurt.

title: Roasted Turkey and Vegetables
Recipe Ingredients: 2 celery stalks (chopped)"3 small or medium carrots, peeled and chopped"1 onion, chopped"½ head cabbage, chopped"5 fresh thyme sprigs (stems removed)
Body: Preheat oven to 375 F. Coat baking dish with cooking spray. Toss veggies thyme together and place in bottom of pan. Pour chicken broth over veggies. Remove skin from turkey breast. Place it breast side up on top of veggies. Drizzle the turkey and veggies with olive oil and sprinkle it with the seasonings. Roast turkey and veggies for 1 hour or until the internal temp of the turkey is 165F. After baking, allow turkey to rest before cutting.

title: Aztec Turkey Quinoa Burgers
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. ground turkey          "1/3 cups quinoa"3 green onion (scallions, minced)"½ cups chopped kale"2 Tbsp. extra virgin olive oil"½ tsp. cumin"1 tsp. dried oregano"1 chipotle chili in adobo
Body: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and mix well to distribute. Shape into 6 patties. Preheat grill to medium high and place burgers on grill grate. Cook under direct heat (with grill closed) for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through to doneness.

title: Parmesan Crusted Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 1 ½ lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast"½ cups cornmeal"1/3 cups parmesan cheese"½ tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. black pepper"3 egg whites
Body: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. In a shallow dish, mix cornmeal, parmesan cheese, garlic powder and black pepper. In another shallow baking dish, whisk together egg whites. Dip chicken breast strip in egg mixture and then drench in cornmeal mixture. Coat well and place on a baking sheet. Repeat procedure for all chicken strips. Spray chicken strips with cooking spray. Bake 15-20 minutes or until done; turn chicken pieces over halfway through cooking time.

title: Chicken Sausage Hash
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Tbsp. olive oil"1 onion, diced"1 cup mushrooms, sliced"1 med red bell pepper, seeded and diced"½ tsp. dried thyme"¼ tsp. red pepper flakes"¼ tsp. black pepper"1 clove minced garlic"2 apple chicken sausage, links, diced"1 lb. sweet potatoes, roasted whole, peeled and diced
Body: Add olive oil and generous amount of cooking spray to a large sauté pan over medium high heat. Sauté the onions mushrooms and red bell pepper for 6-7 minutes or until starting to caramelize. Add the thyme, crushed red pepper flakes, ground black pepper and garlic. Mix well and sauté 1-2 more minutes. Stir in the chicken sausage and water and statue for 3-4 minutes, scraping the bottom of the pan to mix in any brown bits on the bottom. Gently stir in diced, cooked sweet potatoes and serve.

title: Brown Rice Bowl with Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 2 t olive oil           "1 med onion, diced and divided"2 cups cooked pinto beans"1 Tbsp. chili powder"1 tsp. ground cumin"¼ tsp. ground cayenne pepper"¼ tsp. black pepper"½ cup water"1 med tomato, seeded and diced"1 med jalapeno pepper, seeded, deveined, minced"¼ cup cilantro"Juice of 1 lime"2 cups cooked brown rice"½ tsp. salt"2 cups cooked chicken, shredded, warmed"1 avocado, peeled, seeded and sliced"1 lime, sliced
Body:
Add oil to sauté pan over medium heat. Add half the diced onion and the pinto beans, chili powder, cumin, cayenne pepper, black pepper and water. Sauté slightly mashing the beans as you sauté until the liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes. In a small bowl, mix the tomato, jalapeno, pepper, remaining diced onion, cilantro and lime juice. Set aside. Season the brown rice with salt.

In six salad bowls, divide and layer the brown rice, topped with cooked pinto beans, chicken, tomato mixture, sliced avocado and 1 slice of lime.

title: Greek Chicken Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 package romaine lettuce"1 med cucumber"2 plum tomatoes, diced"16 kalamata pitted olives, cut in half"½ small red onion, thinly sliced"¼ crumbled feta cheese, reduced fat"2 cups cooked chicken, diced"16 baked whole wheat pita chips"¼ cup red wine vinegar"½ t dried oregano"1/8 black pepper
Body:
In a medium bowl, mix all salad ingredients, except the pita chips. In a small bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat

Enjoy the pita chips on the side or break into bits and sprinkle over your salad for added crunch.

title: Chicken Antipasto Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 2/5 cup dried whole grain rotini pasta  r "1 ½ cup frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and coarsely chopped  1 boneless skinless chicken breast, chopped"1 medium green bell pepper"8 slices turkey pepperoni, chopped"½ cup thinly sliced red onion"1/3 cup chopped roasted red pepper, drained if bottled"1 ½ tsp. dried basil, crumbled"1 Tbsp. cider vinegar"1 Tbsp. olive oil"1 oz fat free feta cheese
Body: Prepare the pasta using the package directions, omitting the salt. Transfer to a colander. Rinse with cold water to cook immediately. Drain well. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, stir together the artichokes, chicken, bell pepper, pepperoni, onion, roasted peppers and basil. Add the pasta, vinegar and oil to the artichoke mixture and toss gently. Add the feta and toss gently. Serve immediately for peak flavor

title: Oven-Barbecued Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: ¼ cups white vinegar      "¼ cups water"1 Tbsp. corn oil"½ cup ketchup"3 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce"2 Tbsp. diced onion"2 Tbsp. browns sugar"1/8 tsp. garlic powder
Body: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine all sauce ingredients in a small saucepan and simmer for 15 minutes over medium low heat, stirring occasionally. Place chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray. Cover chicken evenly with 1 cup BBQ sauce. Bake for 20-25 minutes, baste with sauce and cook another 5-10 minutes.

title: BBQ Chicken Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lbs. chicken breast       "¼ cup BBQ sauce"4 turkey bacon (cooked crisp and chopped)"2 carrots, shredded"16 oz romaine lettuce, bag, chopped"½ medium red onion (small dice)"1 large cucumber, small dice      "1 large tomato, seeded and diced"½ t salt"½ t black pepper"½ cup poppy seed dressing (fat free)
Body:
Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Line the sheet with chicken breasts and brush each generously with BBQ sauce. Bake for 30 minutes or until internal temperature of chicken is 165 degrees. Set aside to cool.

In a large salad bowl, toss together bacon, carrots, lettuce, onion, cucumber, tomatoes, salt and pepper

Once chicken is cool, chop into small pieces and toss with salad ingredients. Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to coat.

title: Roasted Chicken Breasts
Recipe Ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts    "1 tsp. salt"½ tsp. black pepper"¼ cups lemon juice"2 Tbsp. minced garlic
Body: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. Place the chicken breasts on a baking sheet. In a small bowl, combine salt, pepper, olive oil, lemon juice and whisk until combined. Brush on or pour lemon juice mixture over each chicken breast, coating evenly. Sprinkle each chicken breast evenly with paprika and bake in the oven for 35 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked. Let the chicken breasts rest, covered with foil for 10-15 minutes before slicing or serving.

title: Grilled Mango Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breast cutlets"2 Tbsp. mango salsa"2 Tbsp. fresh lime juice"½ tsp. ground ginger"1 Tbsp. olive oil"¼ cup orange juice"½ tsp. dried oregano"½ tsp. hot pepper sauce
Body: In a large, resealable plastic storage bag combine chicken with remaining ingredients. Place in fridge and marinate 8 hours or overnight, turning halfway during marinating time. Preheat grill to medium high heat. Place chicken on grill, discarding excess marinade. Grill chicken 4-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.

title: Braised Chicken Thighs with Mushrooms
Recipe Ingredients: 1 T olive oil         "1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken thighs"1 tsp. margarine"½ onion, finely diced"8 oz. slices mushrooms"3 Tbsp. balsamic vinegar"1 ½ cup chicken broth (low sodium, fat free)
Body:
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat. Add chicken thighs and sauté for 2 minutes. Add mushrooms and sauté for 3-5 minutes until liquid is released; stirring frequently. Add balsamic vinegar to pan and cook with mushrooms for 1 minute. Add chicken thighs back to pan and place mushrooms on top of chicken. Pour chicken broth into pan.

Bring the chicken broth to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover the pan with a heavy, tight fitting lid and simmer for 25 minutes.

title: Baked Chicken with Maple Butter Glaze
Recipe Ingredients: 1 ½ tsp. paprika"1 tsp. salt"¾ tsp. ground cinnamon"¾ tsp. ground cumin, or use chili powder"1 whole chicken, cut up"2 Tbsp. pure maple syrup"1 ½ Tbsp. butter or margarine"1 ½ Tbsp. Dijon mustard (use wheat/gluten free if needed)
Body:
Preheat the oven to 500 degrees. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray the foil with nonstick cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine the four dry spices. Place chicken pieces skin side up on the baking sheet. Sprinkle and rub the spice mixture evenly over chicken. Position the sheet in the upper third of the oven, about 4 inches from the heating element and bake without turning 15 minutes.

Meanwhile in a small saucepan, combine maple syrup, butter and mustard. Stir over low heat until butter melts. Remove from the heat. After chicken has baked 15 minutes, remove from the oven and brush with the maple glaze; bake 5 more minutes. Brush chicken with the glaze again and bake 5 minutes more. Remove from the oven and serve

title: Grilled Chicken Sausage with Zucchini and Peppers
Recipe Ingredients: 2 large zucchini"1 red bell pepper"4 sun-dried tomato chicken sausage or regular chicken sausage links
Body: Preheat a grill to medium high. Spray grill rack with cooking spray. Add the zucchini and peppers to the grill or veggie basket and grill for 8-10 minutes, until tender. Place the chicken sausage on the grill and heat through for 4-5 minutes, turning frequently.

title: Spinach Salad with Chicken and Avocado
Recipe Ingredients: 2 oz. baby spinach      "1 small avocado cut into slices"2 sliced roma tomatoes"1 cup boneless, skinless diced chicken breast, cooked"4 Tbsp. sunflower seeds"6 Tbsp. light ranch dressing
Body: In a large salad bowl, combine salad ingredients. Add the salad dressing and toss to coat.

title: Honey Mustard Chicken Thighs with Wild Rice
Recipe Ingredients: ¼ cup honey Dijon mustard"1 clove minced garlic"¼ tsp. ground black pepper"¾ tsp. dried thyme"1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken thighs"2 cups cooked wild rice
Body: Preheat oven to 375 degrees. In a small bowl, combine mustard, garlic and pepper. Spread about 1 ½ T mustard mixture evenly on top of each chicken thigh. Arrange chicken in a glass baking dish. Bake for 40 minutes or until mustard mixture has formed a crust and is slightly hardened. Remove from oven and sprinkle thyme of top of chicken. Serve each chicken thigh over ½ cup wild rice.

title: Honey Stone Ground Mustard Chicken Sizzle and Smoke
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Tbsp. olive oil"2 Tbsp. Dijon mustard"2 Tbsp. stone ground mustard"1 Tbsp. honey"1 Tbsp. lemon juice
Body: Combine all of the marinade ingredients in a medium bowl and put into a large, tightly sealed plastic bag. Marinate chicken at least 30 minutes or overnight in the refrigerator for best results. Preheat grill to medium high and place chicken on grill grate. Cook under direct heat (close grill cover) for 8-10 minutes per sides.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Burritos
Recipe Ingredients: 1 avocado (mashed)"4 large whole wheat tortillas"½ cup pico de gallo or jarred salsa"2 cups cooked chicken breast (shredded)"1 cup canned black beans, rinsed and drained"6 T cheddar cheese (reduced fat, shredded)"1 cup lettuce, shredded"1 cup tomatoes, diced
Body: Spread 3 Tbsp. mashed avocado on 1 tortilla. Top with 2 Tbsp. pico de gallo, ½ cup chicken, ¼ cup black beans, 1 ½ Tbsp. cheese, 14 lettuce and ¼ cup diced tomatoes. Fold into burrito. Repeat procedure for remaining 3 burritos

title: Balsamic Chicken with Mushrooms
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. boneless skinless chicken breast"1 Tbsp. olive oil"¼ cups all-purpose flour"1 Tbsp. margarine"10 oz sliced mushrooms"¼ tsp. black pepper"1/3 cup balsamic vinegar"½ cup chicken broth (fat free, less sodium)
Body: Place the chicken breast in a plastic bag and pound thin with a mallet. Heat olive oil over medium-high heat in a skillet. Dredge the chicken in flour and coat it on both sides. Add the chicken to the pan and sauté 5 minutes per side. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. Melt the margarine in the pan. Add the mushrooms and pepper and cook for 5 minutes. Add the balsamic vinegar to the pan and bring it to a boil to reduce the liquid. Add the chicken broth to the pan and simmer 2 more minutes. Add the chicken breast back to the pan and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Sweet Potato and Spinach Chicken Tacos
Recipe Ingredients: 1 ½ T olive oil"1 clove minced garlic"24 oz fresh baby spinach"1 8-oz sweet potato, peeled and diced"¼ tsp. cumin"4 Tbsp. water"1 cup shredded, cooked chicken"4 six-inch corn tortillas, heated"4 tsp. light sour cream"½ cup pico de gallo
Body: In a large nonstick pan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add the spinach and sauté for 3-4 minutes. Add the sweet potato, cumin, black pepper and water to the pan. Sauté for 2 minutes. Cover reduce heat to low and cook for 8 minutes. Add chicken to the pan and mix to incorporate. Heat for 2 minutes. Fill each tortilla with ¼ of the chicken and sweet potato mixture. Top with 1 tsp. of sour cream and 2 Tbsp. of pico de gallo.

title: Spaghetti Squash with Sautéed’ Spinach & Mushrooms
Recipe Ingredients: 2 small or 1 large spaghetti squash         "1 large leek"3 cloves garlic"1 container mushrooms"1 bag baby spinach"1/2 cup chicken bone broth (no added ingredients)"1/8 cup dry white wine, optional"Pink salt and pepper, to taste
Body:
Prepare spaghetti squash. Simply cut in half, scoop out seeds, sprinkle with pink salt and pepper, put upside down on 13x9 pan and bake at 375 degrees for about 45 minutes.

In the meantime, slice the leek in half vertically and wash well to remove dirt. Dry on paper towels and & cut crosswise into thin slices. Sauté the garlic and leek in a little water or coconut amino

Add mushrooms and continue to sauté until mushrooms are soft and lightly browned. Add spinach (don’t worry if it won’t fit in the pan, it will wilt down into nothing in seconds) and pour in chicken bone broth.

Stir the spinach until wilted and add wine. Season with pink salt and pepper. Add spaghetti squash and stir to combine. Adjust seasoning, if needed. Sauté for a few minutes. Serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Zucchini Chili
Recipe Ingredients: 1 small chopped zucchini"1/2 C chopped red onion"garlic powder to taste"chili powder to taste"cumin to taste"1 can petite chopped tomatoes (no added sugars or chemicals)"1 1/2 C water"several slices pickled jalapeños"1/4 cup black beans (maintenance and beyond)
Body:
Bring it all to a boil, then reduce to medium, cooking until it reduces. Cool slightly and serve.

 

This is the perfect losing phase side or an excellent vegetarian meal. If you are in maintenance or beyond, you could also add a few black beans.

title: Bang Bang Cauliflower
Recipe Ingredients: Cauliflower:"1/2 tsp pink salt"1/2 tsp pepper"1 head of cauliflower, cut into florets"Bang bang sauce:"1 tsp sriracha"1 tsp Bragg Liquid Amino"2 tsp lime juice (from fresh lime)"2 garlic cloves, finely chopped"Stevia extract to taste
Body:
Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F and line a baking pan with parchment paper

Mix pink salt and pepper together in a bowl.

Sprinkle pink salt and pepper over cauliflower and Bake for 22-25 minutes.

Mix all the sauce ingredients together in a bowl. Toss the cauliflower and sauce together.

Top with fresh cilantro & sesame seeds (optional omit for losing phase). Serve immediately

title: Indian Cauliflower with Oranges
Recipe Ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into 1-inch florets"1 onion, cut into 1-inch pieces"1 tsp. ground turmeric"2 tsp. of ground cumin"1 tsp. ground ginger"1 tsp. red chili powder"3 oranges, peeled and divided into segments"1 tsp. stevia"½ cup water, or more if necessary"1 serrano or birds eye chili, finely chopped (optional)
Body:
Place the cauliflower, onions in a large bowl and add turmeric, tossing to coat. Heat the water in a large skillet over high heat. Reduce to medium and add veggies. Stir fry for 3-5 minutes, or until golden and lightly browned. Transfer the veggies to a bowl and set aside. Over medium heat add cumin, ground ginger and chili powder, and roast until they begin to change color and become fragrant.

Add the reserved veggies to the pan, and then add the oranges and stevia. Add the water to deglaze the pan. Cover and reduce the heat to a gentle simmer. Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the veggies are cooked but are still lightly firm. Add the chilies, for the last 5 minutes of cooking.

title: Bhindi (Okra) Bhajee
Recipe Ingredients: 8 oz. Bhindi (Okra)"4 ripe tomatoes"Half medium onion-very finely chopped"Fresh red chilies-deseeded and veined-then chopped. The quantity is up to you"½ tsp. turmeric"½ tsp. garam masala"Salt to taste
Body:
Wash, then top and tail the bhindi. Cut the tomatoes in half down through the stalk area and place, skin uppermost, under a hot grill until the skins begin to blacken. Remove from grill, let cool a little, and then remove skins. Remove seeds and white core then coarsely chop the tomato flesh. In a heavy heated pan add the chopped onion and stir for a few minutes with the heat on high. Add the cumin seeds, stir a little then turn the heat down to low and cook for 10 minutes.

Add garlic and chilies, stir and cook for another 10 minutes on low heat stirring now and again to make sure nothing browns or burns.

Add the turmeric and stir gently for a minute. Add the tomato flesh, bhindi garam masala and salt. Stir to mix all ingredients.

Cook on low heat for 20 minutes or until the bhindi is cooked. Stir occasionally and very gently so as not to break up the bhindi. Add water if it gets too dry. You want to end up with the bhindi covered in a thick tomato mixture and no watery sauce.

title: Braised Cabbage and Beets
Recipe Ingredients: Shred 1 onion"½ red cabbage"Chop 4 cooked beets"½ celery stock"½ balsamic vinegar"Salt and pepper to taste"1 shredded apple (optional)
Body: Sauté onions and cabbage in stock until tender (may pre boil cabbage if desired). Add chopped beets, vinegar and salt and pepper. Simmer gently for 20-30 minutes until all veggies are very tender. Serve hot

title: Beet and Orange Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 bag champêtre diced beets"1 ½ orange"1 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1 Tbsp. Dijon mustard"3 Tbsp. stock"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Juice the half orange. Pour juice, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper into a salad bowl. While whisking, gradually add in stock. Add beets and mix until well coated in dressing. Slice off peel and pith from other orange, then cut into sections. Gently add orange sections to salad. Garnish with parsley.

title: Vegan Zucchini Pasta
Recipe Ingredients: 2 pounds zucchini (approx. 4-5 large zucchini), spiralized"1-pint cherry tomatoes, halved"1 large red onion (or two small), thinly sliced"4 garlic cloves, minced"1/2 cup fresh basil"Pink salt & pepper to taste"1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper (optional)
Body:
Start by warming some water in a large pot over low to medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook for 3 minutes, until fragrant.

Next add the zucchini noodles to the pot and season them with salt & pepper. Cover the pot with a lid and allow to cook for 2 minutes, stirring halfway through.

Add the tomatoes to the pot and continue to cook for another 3-4 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds or so. I prefer to use tongs to toss the noodles so that they cook evenly, and I also like them a little firm. You can taste test a piece of zucchini noodle at this point to see if it’s soft enough for your liking. If not, continue to cook for another couple of minutes.

Lastly, add the fresh basil, and crushed red pepper (if using), to the pot then stir together. Divide the pasta onto separate plates and garnish with fresh basil.

Serve warm and enjoy

title: Vegan Egg Roll in a Bowl
Recipe Ingredients: 1 small cabbage, thinly sliced            "2 large carrots, shredded"2 portobello mushrooms, thinly sliced"1 onion, diced"2-3 cloves garlic, minced"1-2 T coconut aminos"1-inch fresh ginger, minced"Pink Salt (if needed)"1/4 cup green onions (optional for garnish)
Body:
In a large sauté pan, on medium heat, add the onion with water or coconut amino. Cover and cook for a couple minutes until the onions soften.

Add the remaining ingredients, cover and cook for about 7- 10 minutes, making sure to stir at least once.

Taste. If it needs pink salt, you can add it now. Serve with green onions as garnish if you like.

title: Spaghetti Squash Chow Mein
Recipe Ingredients: Spaghetti Squash Chow Mein"1/4 cup COCONUT AMINOS"3 cloves garlic, minced"2 teaspoons freshly grated ginger"1/4 teaspoon white pepper (or black pepper!)"1 onion, diced"3 stalks celery, sliced diagonally"2 cups coleslaw mix (shredded cabbage and carrots)
Body:
Cut a spaghetti squash in half-length wise and scoop out seeds. Lay skin side up in a 13 x 9 Pyrex and pour 1/2 inch of water in the bottom of the pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 30-40 minutes, until flesh is very tender. Once done, scoop out flesh with a fork so it breaks apart into strings, set aside.

In a small bowl, whisk together coconut aminos, garlic, ginger and white pepper; set aside

Heat some water or more coconut amino in a large skillet over medium high heat. Add onion and celery, and cook, stirring often, until tender, about 3-4 minutes.

Stir in cabbage until heated through, about 1 minute. Stir in spaghetti squash and sauce mixture until well combined, about 2 minutes.

Serve immediately.

title: Portabella Mushroom Tacos
Recipe Ingredients: 1 pound portobello mushrooms     "1/4 cup spicy harissa, or use a mild harissa (omit during the losing phase) replace with fresh jalapeño and/or homemade pico)"1 teaspoon ground cumin"1 teaspoon onion powder"6 collard green leaves"Guacamole:"2 medium ripe avocados"2 tablespoons chopped tomatoes"2 tablespoons chopped red onion"1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons lemon or lime juice"pinch of pink salt"1 tablespoon chopped cilantro"Good Optional Toppings for losing phase and beyond:"chopped tomatoes"chopped cilantro"fresh jalapeno
Body:
Remove the stem of the portobellos. Rinse mushrooms and pat dry.

Mix harissa, cumin, and onion powder in a bowl. Brush each mushroom with the harissa mixture, making sure to cover the edges of the mushroom as well. Let mushroom marinade for 15 minutes. If you are in the losing phase simply omit the harrisa and let stand with other ingredients.

While the mushrooms are marinating, prepare guacamole. Halve and pit the avocados and scoop out the flesh. Mash avocados and mix in chopped tomatoes, red onion, lemon (or lime) juice, salt, and cilantro. Set aside.

Rinse collard greens. Chop off the tough stems and set aside.

When the mushrooms are done marinating, heat 1 1/2 tablespoons of water in pan. Place the portobello mushrooms in the pan and cook for 3 minutes. Flip over and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes. Each side should be browned.

Turn off the heat and let the mushrooms rest for 2 to 3 minutes before slicing. Take a collard green leaf and fill it with a few slices of portobello. Add guacamole, chopped tomatoes, and cilantro or other optional ingredients to your liking

title: Cabbage Stir Fry
Recipe Ingredients: ½ cabbage, sliced thin"2 Tbsp. lemon juice"2 T fresh parsley chopped fine"2 Tbsp. balsamic vinegar"2 Tbsp. green onion chopped"½ tsp. garlic powder"½ tsp. onion powder"1/6 purple onion, julienned"Salt & pepper to taste"½ onion, grated
Body: Place the cabbage, lemon juice, onions, & garlic powders, salt & pepper in a sauté’ pan. Cook over medium heat until cabbage begins to soften. Stir in the balsamic vinegar and fresh parsley and serve.

title: Zucchini Pasta
Recipe Ingredients: 2 pounds zucchini (approx. 4-5 large zucchini), spiralize"1-pint cherry tomatoes, halved"1 large red onion (or two small), thinly sliced"4 garlic cloves, minced"1/2 cup fresh basil"Pink salt & pepper to taste"1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper (optional)
Body:
Start by warming a bit of water (2T) large pot over low to medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook for 3 minutes, until fragrant.

Next add the zucchini noodles to the pot and season them with salt & pepper. Cover the pot with a lid and allow to cook for 2 minutes, stirring halfway through.

Add the tomatoes to the pot and continue to cook for another 3-4 minutes, stirring every 30 seconds or so. I prefer to use tongs to toss the noodles so that they cook evenly and I also like them a little firm. You can taste test a piece of zucchini noodle at this point to see if it’s soft enough for your liking. If not, continue to cook for another couple of minutes.

Lastly, add the fresh basil, crushed red pepper (if using), to the pot then stir together. Divide the pasta onto separate plates and garnish with fresh basil. Serve warm and enjoy

Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container. The zucchini will produce a little bit of water as it sits but you can just pour it out before reheating

title: Spaghetti Squash & Mushrooms
Recipe Ingredients: 1 2-3 lb. spaghetti squash"2 red onions, peeled and sliced into longer strips if possible"1½ cup mushrooms"1 cup kale"¼ tsp rosemary (I used fresh, but dried would work too)"Pink Salt and pepper to taste
Body:
Preheat oven to 350°.

Slice squash in half, remove seeds and place face down on baking sheet.

While squash is roasting, turn skillet on medium. Add a little water or coconut Amino. Add onions to skillet, stirring occasionally. After 5 minutes, add mushrooms.

After approximately 10 minutes, the onions should start to caramelize a bit.

Add kale to skillet and continue to stir everything together until onions turn a nice golden brown color.

After about 35 minutes, remove squash from oven and allow 10 or so minutes for it to cool off.

Once slightly cooler, use a fork to remove "spaghetti" from squash and place in a skillet; add rosemary, salt and pepper and stir everything together.

title: Tofu with Fire Roasted Tomatoes and Zucchini Noodles
Recipe Ingredients: Extra firm tofu"1 can of Muir Glen Fire Roasted Tomatoes"1 tsp. Red Curry Paste"Spiralized zucchini"Optional - Pink Salt
Body:
Tofu: Extra Firm. Steamed 10 minutes in the Instant Pot.

Sauce: 1 can- Muir Glen Fire Roasted Tomatoes & 1 tsp Red Curry Paste. Be sure to check ingredients of the paste to be sure it does not contain any added oils or sugars. Mix and heat on the stovetop.

For zucchini noodles: Spiralize desired amount of zucchini. You can eat raw or you may steam for a few minutes and season. Combine all ingredients and serve.

title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Apples
Recipe Ingredients: 1 (1-1 ½ pound) pork tenderloins"1 ½ tsp. Dijon mustard"1 Tbsp. chopped fresh thyme leaves"¼ tsp. ground black pepper"¼ tsp. ground black pepper"2 apples, cored and sliced"2 onions, sliced"1 cup chicken stock
Body:
Heat oven to 425 degrees. Trim each tenderloin of any sliver skin (this can be tough when cooked, just use a small sharp knife and slide the blade under and outward to remove it.) Pat pork dry with paper towels, then using your hands, sprinkle with 1 ½ t of salt, and rub until both tenderloins are evenly coated. Add the tenderloins and cook, turning occasionally, until evenly browned all over. This should take about 12 minutes. Transfer the browned pork to a large plate or cutting board. Add apples and onions, then cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned around edges, about 5 minutes.

While the apples and onions cook, use a pastry brush or hands to rub the pork all over with mustard, sprinkle it with 2 t of thyme and pepper, and rub until it’s evenly coated. Add the remaining t of thyme to the apples and onions, stir. Then place pork tenderloins on top of apples and onions and slide into the oven. Roast 10-15 minutes or until an internal thermometer inserted into the thickest part registers between 145 and 150 degrees.

Transfer pork to a large plate and cover with aluminum foil. Let rest about 10 minutes. While the pork rests, place the pan with apples and onions back into the stove and turn heat to medium. Add chicken stock and use a wooden spoon to scrape the pan, lifting any brown bits from the bottom. Bring to a simmer and cook until reduced by half. Slice pork into 1-inch slices then serve on a bed of apples and onions with pan sauce drizzled on top.

title: Pork Balchao
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Tbsp. grated fresh root ginger"1 Tbsp. crushed garlic"1-inch piece cinnamon stick, broken up"2-4 dried red chilies, chopped or torn"4 cloves"2 tsp. cumin seeds"10 black peppercorns             "½ tsp. chili powder (optional)"1 ½ cubed leg of pork, crackling and other visible fat removed"1 tsp. ground turmeric"1 cup warm water"1 ½ Tbsp. tomato puree (paste)"1 large onion, finely sliced"1 tsp. stevia"1 tsp. salt"2 Tbsp. cider vinegar
Body:
Heat 1 Tbsp. of water in a wok or large pan and add the ginger and garlic. Fry for 30 seconds. Grind the cinnamon stick, dried chilies, cloves, cumin seed and peppercorns to a fine powder, using a spice mill or grinder. Add the spice mix to the pan and fry for another 30 seconds, stirring. Add the pork and turmeric and increase the heat slightly. Fry for 5-6 minutes or until the meat starts to release its juices stirring regularly. Add the water, tomato puree and chili powder, and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer for 30-40 minutes.

Fry the sliced onion for 8-9 minutes until browned, stirring regularly. Add the onion to the pork along with salt, stevia and cider vinegar. Stir, cover and simmer for 30-35 minutes or until the pork is tender. Remove from heat and spoon into a serving dish. Garnish with fresh chilies and serve

title: Spice and Onion Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 1 large onion, grated"2 Tbsp. freshly grated lemon zest"2 tsp. ground cumin"1 tsp. allspice"1 tsp. salt"½ tsp. black pepper"2-4 bone in, skin on chicken breast (about 2 lbs. total)
Body:
In a large bowl, combine onion, lemon zest, cumin, allspice, salt and pepper. Add chicken, cover, and marinate in refrigerator at least 1 hour and up to overnight.

Heat oven to 375 degrees. Lightly coat sheet pan with cooking spray. Remove chicken from marinade, pat dry, and place on a prepared pan, skin side up. Discard marinade. Roast until meat thermometer registers 150 degrees when inserted into the thickest part of chicken, about 20 minutes. Heat broiler. Cook chicken until golden

title: Indian Cauliflower with Oranges
Recipe Ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into 1-inch florets"1 onion, cut into 1-inch pieces"1 tsp. ground turmeric"2 tsp. of ground cumin"1 tsp. red chili powder"3 oranges, peeled and divided into segments"1 tsp. stevia"½ cup water, or more if necessary"1 serrano or birds eye chili, finely chopped (optional)
Body:
Place the cauliflower, onions in a large bowl and add turmeric, tossing to coat. Heat the water in a large skillet over high heat. Reduce to medium and add veggies. Stir fry for 3-5 minutes, or until golden and lightly browned. Transfer the veggies to a bowl and set aside. Over medium heat add cumin, ground ginger and chili powder, and roast until they begin to change color and become fragrant.

Add the reserved veggies to the pan, and then add the oranges and stevia. Add the water to deglaze the pan. Cover and reduce the heat to a gentle simmer. Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the veggies are cooked but are still lightly firm. Add the chilies, for the last 5 minutes of cooking.

title: Chicken Jalfrezi
