Recipe Ingredients: 1 ½ cubed leg of pork, crackling and other visible fat removed"1 Tbsp. grated fresh root ginger"1 Tbsp. crushed garlic"1-inch piece cinnamon stick, broken up"2-4 dried red chilies, chopped or torn"4 cloves"2 tsp. cumin seeds"10 black peppercorns"1 tsp. ground turmeric"1 cup warm water"1 ½ Tbsp. tomato puree (paste)"½ tsp. chili powder (optional)"1 large onion, finely sliced"1 tsp. salt"1 tsp. stevia"2 Tbsp. cider vinegar"Fresh chilies, to garnish
Body: Heat 1 Tbsp. of water in a wok or large pan and add the ginger and garlic. Fry for 30 seconds. Grind the cinnamon stick, dried chilies, cloves, cumin seed and peppercorns to a fine powder, using a spice mill or grinder. Add the spice mix to the pan and fry for another 30 seconds, stirring. Add the pork and turmeric and increase the heat slightly. Fry for 5-6 minutes or until the meat starts to release its juices stirring regularly. Add the water, tomato puree and chili powder, and bring to the boil. Cover and simmer for 30-40 minutes. Fry the sliced onion for 8-9 minutes until browned, stirring regularly. Add the onion to the pork along with salt, stevia and cider vinegar. Stir, cover and simmer for 30-35 minutes or until the pork is tender. Remove from heat and spoon into a serving dish. Garnish with fresh chilies and serve.

title: Spice and Onion Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 1 large onion, grated"2 Tbsp. freshly grated lemon zest"2 tsp. ground cumin"1 tsp. allspice"1 tsp. salt"½ tsp. black pepper"2-4 bone in, skin on chicken breast (about 2 lbs. total)
Body: In a large bowl, combine onion, lemon zest, cumin, allspice, salt and pepper. Add chicken, cover, and marinate in refrigerator at least 1 hour and up to overnight. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Lightly coat sheet pan with cooking spray. Remove chicken from marinade, pat dry, and place on a prepared pan, skin side up. Discard marinade. Roast until meat thermometer registers 150 degrees when inserted into the thickest part of chicken, about 20 minutes. Heat broiler. Cook chicken until golden.

title: Indian Lamb Curry (works with any cubed meat)
Recipe Ingredients: 1 ½ lbs. boneless lamb, trimmed of fat and cut into 1-inchpieces"2 bay leaves"1 black cardamom pod"1 (2 inch) cinnamon stick"10 peppercorns"4 whole cloves"1 ½ large onions, finely chopped"1 tsp. ground ginger or grated fresh ginger root"2 tsp. coriander powder"1 tsp. cayenne pepper"1 ½ tsp. garam masala"1 cup diced tomato"2 Tbsp. chopped fresh cilantro leaves
Body: Heat water in a large pan; add bay leaves, cardamom, cinnamon stick, peppercorns and cloves. When leaves begin to sizzle, and fragrance starts to release, add onions and sauté until light golden, about 12-15 minutes, stirring frequently. Stir in the ginger, garlic, chilies, pepper and lamb. Season the lamb with salt; continue cooking, stirring mix for about 20 minutes more, adding a little more water if necessary, to keep food from sticking. Add turmeric, coriander powder, Cayenne and garam masala; stir for 5 minutes, adding 2 T of water. Add diced tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes and stir frequently

title: Indian Cauliflower with Oranges
Recipe Ingredients: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into 1-inch florets"onion, cut into 1-inch pieces"1 tsp. ground turmeric"2 tsp. of ground cumin"1 tsp. ground ginger"1 tsp. red chili powder"3 oranges, peeled and divided into segments"1 tsp. stevia"½ cup water, or more if necessary"1 serrano or birds eye chili, finely chopped (optional)
Body: Place the cauliflower, onions in a large bowl and add turmeric, tossing to coat. Heat the water in a large skillet over high heat. Reduce to medium and add veggies. Stir fry for 3-5 minutes, or until golden and lightly browned. Transfer the veggies to a bowl and set aside. Over medium heat add cumin, ground ginger and chili powder, and roast until they begin to change color and become fragrant. Add the reserved veggies to the pan, and then add the oranges and stevia. Add the water to deglaze the pan. Cover and reduce the heat to a gentle simmer. Simmer for 15 minutes, or until the veggies are cooked but are still lightly firm. Add the chilies, for the last 5 minutes of cooking.

title: Chicken Jalfrezi
Recipe Ingredients: 1 ½ lb. chicken breast portions"1 tsp. cumin seed"1 onion, finely chopped"1 green pepper, seeded and finely chopped"1 red pepper, seeded and finely chopped"1 garlic clove, crushed"2 ¾ inch piece fresh root ginger, finely chopped"1 Tbsp. curry paste"¼ tsp. chili powder"1 tsp. ground coriander"1 tsp. ground cumin"½ tsp. salt"1 4 oz. can chopped tomatoes"2 Tbsp. chopped fresh coriander (cilantro), plus extra to garnish
Body: Skin the chicken breast portions and remove any visible fat. Cut the meat into 1-inch cubes. Heat the oil in a wok, or heavy pan and fry the cumin seeds for 2 minutes until they splutter. Add the onion, peppers, garlic and ginger and fry 6-8 minutes. Add the curry paste and fry for about 2 minutes. Stir in the chili powder, ground coriander, cumin and salt and add 1 tsp. water: fry for 6-8 minutes. Add the chicken cubes and fry for about 5 minutes. Add the canned tomatoes and chopped fresh coriander. Cover the pan tightly with a lid and cook for about 15 minutes or until the chicken cubes are tender. Garnish with sprigs of fresh coriander.

title: Ground Chicken/Turkey Kofta Kebabs
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. ground chicken or turkey"1 garlic clove"¼ c. onion, grated"2 Tbsp. red peppers, grated"2 Tbsp. parsley"1 Tbsp. ground coriander"1 tsp. ground cumin"¼ tsp. ground cinnamon"¼ tsp. cayenne pepper"¼ tsp. ground ginger"¼ tsp. ground black pepper"1 pinch salt"1 pinch ground cloves"1 pinch nutmeg
Body: Mince garlic. Shred onion and pepper. Mix all ingredients together with a spoon until evenly mixed. You can put in the refrigerator from 30 to 24 hours. Use water on hands and form on skewers. Cook them on preheated lightly oiled grill, pan, broil, turning every 2 minutes until completely cooked 6-10 minutes.

title: Bhindi (Okra) Bhajee
Recipe Ingredients: 8 oz. Bhindi (Okra)"4 ripe tomatoes"Half medium onion-very finely chopped"Chopped fresh red chilies-deseeded and veined. The quantity is up to you"½ tsp. turmeric"½ tsp. garam masala"Salt to taste
Body: Wash, then top and tail the bhindi. Cut the tomatoes in half down through the stalk area and place, skin uppermost, under a hot grill press until the skins begin to blacken. Remove from grill, let cool, and then remove skins. Remove seeds and white core from tomato and coarsely chop the tomato flesh. In a heavy heated pan add the chopped onion and stir for a few minutes with the heat on high. Add the cumin seeds, stir a little then turn the heat down to low and cook for 10 minutes. Add garlic and chilies, stir and cook for another 10 minutes on low heat stirring now and again to make sure nothing browns or burns. Add the turmeric and stir gently for a minute. Add the tomato flesh, bhindi garam masala and salt. Stir to mix all ingredients. Cook on low heat for 20 minutes or until the bhindi is cooked. Stir occasionally and very gently so as not to break up the bhindi. Add water if it gets too dry. You want to end up with the bhindi covered in a thick tomato mixture and no watery sauce.

title: Braised Cabbage and Beets
Recipe Ingredients: 1 onion, shredded"½ red cabbage"4 cooked beets, chopped"½ celery stock"½ balsamic vinegar"Salt and pepper to taste"1 apple, shredded (optional)
Body: Sauté onions and cabbage in stock until tender (may pre boil cabbage if desired). Add chopped beets, vinegar and salt and pepper. Simmer gently for 20-30 minutes until all veggies are very tender. Serve hot.

title: Beet and Orange Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 bag champêtre diced beets"1 ½ orange"1 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1 Tbsp. Dijon mustard"3 Tbsp. stock"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Juice the half orange. Pour juice, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper into a salad bowl. While whisking, gradually add in stock. Add beets and mix until well coated in dressing. Slice off peel and pith from second orange, then cut into sections. Gently add orange sections to salad. Garnish with parsley

title: Beef and Kale Stir Fry
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lb. flank steak, sliced"½ tsp. salt"½ onion, grated"cloves garlic, chopped"¼ tsp. crushed red pepper"7 cups stemmed, quartered kale"¼ tsp. stevia"2 Tbsp. oyster sauce"1 Tbsp. soy sauce"1 8 oz. can sliced water chestnuts
Body: Toss beef with ¼ tsp. salt. Brown beef; add onion, garlic and red pepper; cook for 30 seconds; reserve. Reduce heat; add kale, stevia and ¼ tsp salt. Add 1 cup water and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in ¼ cup water, oyster sauce, soy sauce, water chestnuts and beef; warm through.

title: Spicy BBQ Sauce and Marinade
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 2 12 oz. jars of salsa (less than 1-gram sugar per serving)"¾ c. lemon juice"2 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce"5 tsp. stevia"2 tsp. salt"4 tsp. chili powder"½ tsp. Tabasco sauce to taste"Garlic powder to taste
Body: Combine and refrigerate. Makes 24 servings

title: No Sugar Strawberry Jam
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 c. cold water"4 tsp. stevia
Body: In a large saucepan, crush strawberries. Add water and stevia, mixing well. Over medium heat, bring mixture to boil, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes. Pour into jars, allow to cool and then cover.

title: Strawberry Balsamic Syrup
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"2 Tbsp. water"1 tsp. balsamic vinegar"3 tsp. stevia
Body: In microwave safe bowl, combine all ingredients and toss. Microwave for 2-3 minutes until berries soften.

title: Cocktail Sauce
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 1 c Sugar free ketchup (Simple Girl brand)"3 Tbsp. horseradish sauce (or to taste)
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Vinaigrette Dressing
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: ¼ c. apple cider vinegar"½ c. water"½ tsp. thyme"½ tsp. onion powder"Ground pepper to taste"3 tsp. stevia"Garlic powder to taste"Oregano to taste
Body: Combine and refrigerate

title: Fresh Salsa
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 4-5 tomatoes"4 Tbsp. lemon juice"3-4 Tbsp. garlic, minced"½ chopped onion"1 tsp. finely chopped jalapeno or serrano peppe"½ tsp. chili powder"½ tsp. Italian seasoning"Cayenne pepper to taste"Cilantro (fresh or dried) to taste"Salt and pepper
Body: Put all the ingredients in the food processor. Blend to desired consistency. Refrigerate to blend the flavors. The longer it sits the more flavors it will have. Make pico de gallo by rough chopping all ingredients and skipping the blender

title: Dill Dressing
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 5 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"2 Tbsp. water"2 Tbsp. dried basil"2 Tbsp. dried dill"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. dry mustard"1 tsp. onion powder
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Vinaigrette
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1 Tbsp. lemon juice"Pinch of salt"Pinch of cayenne (optional)"Fresh ground black pepper to taste"Stevia to taste
Body: Combine all ingredients in food processor. Puree until smooth. Great over spinach salad garnished with fresh sliced strawberries.

title: Balsamic Vinaigrette
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: ¼ c. balsamic vinegar"2 Tbsp. water"2 Tbsp. dried thyme"1 Tbsp. dried basil"¼ tsp. garlic powder"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Add all ingredients in a blender and mix well

title: Smoky BBQ Sauce
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 2 Tbsp. sugar-free tomato sauce"½ tsp. dried minced onion"½ tsp. apple cider vinegar"¼ tsp. sugar free liquid smoke"¼ tsp. paprika"¼ tsp. chili powder"Pinch of cinnamon"Pinch of cloves"Stevia if needed
Body: In small nonstick saucepan, combine all ingredients and bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Gravy
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: ½ c. homemade chicken broth"1 Grissini or 1 Melba toast ground to a powder in the food processor or blender
Body: Add ¼ c. broth to small saucepan and bring to a boil. Add powdered grissini/melba toast powder to the pan, whisking constantly until dissolved. Still whisking, add remaining ¼ c. broth. Reduce heat to medium and whisk for 3-4 minutes until thickened. Season to taste.

title: Taco Seasoning
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Tbsp. chili powder"2 tsp. onion powder"1 tsp. ground cumin"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. adobo powder"1 tsp. paprika

title: Oil free Salad Dressing
Recipe Category: Losing Phase, Sauces, Seasonings and Dressings
Recipe Ingredients: ½ c. unfiltered apple cider vinegar"¼ c. lemon juice"1 Tbsp. water"Plain or lemon or orange flavored stevia
Body: Flavor it up with any of the following seasonings: salt and pepper, dried shallots, garlic powder, onion powder, chives, dried cilantro, parsley, dry mustard, basil, stevia (plain or lemon or orange flavored)

title: Favorite Shrimp/Scallops/Tilapia Ceviche
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. shrimp/Scallops/Tilapia, fresh or frozen, raw or cooked, peeled"Juice of 1 large lemon"Juice of 1 large lime"1 mild pepper, ribs and seeds removed, finely chopped"½ red onion, finely chopped"1 large tomatoes chopped"1 cucumber, peeled and diced into ½ inch pieces"¼ c. fresh cilantro chopped"¼ c. fresh parsley, chopped"Sea salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
Body: Thaw shrimp if frozen. If using raw shrimp, bring a pot of water to a boil and cook shrimp for 1-2 minutes until it turns opaque. Do not overcook the shrimp as it will become rubbery. Rinse shrimp under cold water. If using scallops, thaw but do not cook prior to using. If using tilapia, thaw but do not cook prior to using. For a delicious recipe, combine all three shrimp, tilapia, and scallops. Using a total of 4 ounces when combined. Combine juice of lemons and limes in a large glass bowl or large Ziploc bag and add shrimp. Cover bowl or seal bag and refrigerate for 30 minutes to marinate. Large shrimp could be cut into smaller chunks to speed up marinating process. To shrimp, onion and pepper, and mix evenly. Refrigerate 30 additional minutes so the flavors infuse the shrimp. Before serving, place shrimp mixture in a bowl and toss with cilantro, tomatoes, parsley, and cucumbers. If needed, add sea salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Lemon Zest Crab Cakes
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. crab"1 garlic clove, minced"1 Tbsp. onion powder"1 tsp. old bay seasoning"¼ tsp. salt"¼ tsp. pepper"1 tsp. dry mustard"1 Tbsp. parsley"1 tsp. lemon zest
Body: Heat a sauté pan to medium heat. Mix ingredients together and make 2 small patties. Place in pan and cook until brown on each side. Serve with a side of lemon wedge.

title: Lemon Dill Fish
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. white fish"1 Tbsp. minced onion"2 Tbsp. lemon juice"1 sprig of dill"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Place fish and all ingredients into a foil packet top with lemon and dill and wrap and seal the foil into a packet. Place on the BBQ or in oven at 350 degrees. Cook fish for 5-10 minutes or until fish is thoroughly cooked. Serve with lemon.

title: Chilean Sea Bass
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. sea bass filets"½ lemon"½ tsp. salt"½ tsp. lemon pepper"½ tsp. chopped dill"2 Tbsp. finely chopped cilantro"½ tsp. paprika
Body: Wrap fish and all ingredients in a foil packet and bake at 405 for 20 minutes.

title: Easy Lemon pepper Tilapia
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. tilapia filet"Lemon pepper seasoning"Lemon, thinly sliced"Salt to taste
Body: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray baking sheet with spray oil. Place tilapia filets on baking sheet and season with salt, pepper and lemon pepper seasoning. Top with two lemon slices. Bake in oven for 15 minutes or until fish is easily flaked with fork.

title: Sautéed Scallops
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. scallops"¼ tsp. salt"¼ tsp. pepper"One lemon
Body: Spray a nonstick frying pan with spray oil and place scallops or shrimp on pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Simmer by covering with lid for 10 minutes. Sauté scallops until cooked through and both sides are evenly browned. Substitute shrimp but cook only until pink on both sides

title: Fried Chicken Nuggets
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken chopped into nugget sized pieces"1 grissini bread stick or 4 Melba toast snacks"Salt and pepper to taste"½ tsp. paprika"¼ tsp. ground red pepper"½ tsp. garlic powder
Body: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Slice chicken breast into 3 tenders. Grind breadstick in food processor until it is a powder. Put grissini powder in a separate bowl and mix in seasonings. Spray chicken with a small amount of spray oil then dredge in grissini powder and seasonings. Place chicken in baking dish and bake 30-40 minutes, turning over halfway through. During the last 5 minutes, turn on broiler and broil 2-3 minutes each side. Optionally place in air fryer oven and press the chicken setting.

title: Chicken Taco Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 2 c. shredded iceberg lettuce"4 oz. ground chicken or turkey"½ tsp. garlic salt"¼ tsp. chili seasoning"¼ tsp. ground cumin"¼ tsp. adobo seasoning"Crumbled Melba toast
Body: Sauté ground chicken and spices. Arrange lettuce and place chicken on top of lettuce and top with Melba toast.

title: Cornish Game Hens
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. Cornish game hen"1 c. diced onions"½ tsp. poultry seasoning"½ tsp. old bay seasoning"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Put seasoning on birds. Arrange onions in roasting pan. Place bird, breast side up, on onions. Roast in 375-degree oven for 55 to 65 minutes or until tender, basting with juices as needed. Make sure hens are thoroughly cooked.

title: Grilled Chicken or Turkey burger
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground chicken or turkey breast"¼ tsp. pepper"¼ tsp. onion powder"1 tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. dry mustard"Salt to taste"Montreal steak seasoning to taste
Body: Add all the ingredients to the ground chicken breast, Make into a small patty. Grill or broil.

title: Egg Roll
Recipe Ingredients: 2-3 big cabbage leaves"1 c. shredded cabbage"1/8 tsp. onion salt"1/8 tsp. garlic powder"1/8 tsp. Chinese Five Spice"1/2 packet stevia"2 Sesame flavored Melba Toast rounds"4 oz. cooked chopped chicken or shrimp
Body: Steam big cabbage leaves & shredded cabbage 5 minutes. Add all ingredients together. Mix and then wrap in big cabbage leaves. Garnish with Melba rounds. Feel free to add as much shredded cabbage is desired. Its FREE!

title: Crockpot Chicken Chili
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken breast"1 c. shredded cabbage"½ chopped yellow bell pepper"4 c. chicken broth"1 tsp. paprika"1 tsp. black pepper"1 Tbsp. chili powder"1 Tbsp. cumin"½ chopped white onion"Add cayenne pepper to taste
Body: Add all ingredients into a crock-pot and cook on low for 4- 6 hours.

title: Blackened Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless chicken breast"¼ tsp. paprika"¼ tsp. cayenne pepper"¼ tsp. ground cumin"¼ tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. onion powder"¼ tsp. dried thyme"Pinch of ground white pepper"Salt to taste
Body: Heat a skillet over high heat for 5 minutes until hot. Mix seasonings and coat the chicken breasts evenly with the spice mixture. Spray hot pan with a small amount of cooking spray oil. Place the chicken in the hot pan and cook for 1 minute. Turn, and cook 1 minute on other side. Reduce heat to low and cover chicken. Cook for about 5-10 minutes over low until cooked thoroughly.

title: Curry Chicken and Baby Spinach
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless skinless chicken breast"2 c. baby spinach"2 tsp. onion powder"1 tsp. garlic powder"½ c. chicken broth"¼ tsp. salt"¼ tsp. pepper"juice of 1 lime"½ Tbsp. curry powder
Body: Heat a pan on stovetop over medium heat. Mix half the lime juice and all the seasonings and coat chicken. Cook the chicken through. Add spinach for 1 minute and serve in a bowl. Just prior to serving, squeeze the other ½ the lime juice over mixture.

title: Lemon Roasted Chicken and Veggies
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken breasts, chopped"½ c. bell peppers, chopped"¼ onion chopped"½ zucchini, chopped"1/2 c. Brussel sprouts chopped"½ c. broccoli florets"½ c cauliflower florets"¼ c tomatoes, chopped"2 Tbsp. Lemon juice"½ tsp. pink Himalayan salt"½ t black pepper"½ tsp. Italian seasoning"¼ tsp. paprika (optional)
Body: Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Chop all veggies into large pieces and the chicken into cubes. Place the chicken and vegetables in a medium roasting pan. Add the lemon juice, salt, and pepper, Italian seasoning, and paprika. Toss to combine. Bake for 15 minutes or until the veggies are charred and chicken is cooked thoroughly

title: Sautéed Lemon Basil Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless chicken breast, cooked and cubed"¼ c. finely chopped onion"1 clove garlic, chopped"2 ½ c. chopped tomatoes"¼ c. chopped fresh basil"Juice of half a lemon"½ tsp. salt"¼ tsp. paprika"cayenne or red pepper flakes to taste"Stevia to taste
Body: Heat skillet to medium heat. Sauté the onions and garlic. Stir in the tomatoes, chicken, basil, salt, hot pepper and paprika. Reduce heat to medium, and cover skillet for about 5 minutes, stirring frequently until mixture is hot, and tomatoes are soft. Add stevia to taste.

title: Easy Crockpot Salsa Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. skinless boneless chicken breasts"½ c. salsa (no added sugar)
Body: Add chicken breasts and salsa to crock pot and cook on low for 4-6 hours.

title: Apple Chicken Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken, cooked and diced"1 apple chopped"3 stalks celery, diced"2 Tbsp. lemon juice"1  Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"Pinch of cinnamon"Pinch of nutmeg"Pinch of cardamom"Pinch of salt"Stevia to taste"Lemon wedge
Body: Mix ingredients together; sprinkle with stevia and cinnamon. Chill for 30 minutes before serving. Splash with lemon juice from lemon wedge just before serving.

title: Turkey Sausage Spinach
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground turkey"1 (10 oz.) box frozen chopped spinach or 4 oz fresh spinach"½ c. water"¼ tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. onion powder"½ tsp. sage"¼ tsp. thyme"¼ tsp. fennel"¼ tsp. dill"Pinch of nutmeg"Pinch of cayenne"Pink Himalayan salt and pepper to taste"¼ tsp. stevia
Body: Cook turkey thoroughly in a skillet until beginning to brown. Remove from pan and set aside. Add water to skillet and bring to a boil. Add spinach to skillet then cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes or until water is almost gone. Stir in all spices, stevia, and turkey and cook another 5 minutes.

title: Mexican Taco Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 2 c. shredded iceberg lettuce"4 oz. lean ground beef/sirloin/buffalo"½ tsp. garlic salt"¼ tsp. chili seasonings"crumbled melba toast
Body: Sauté ground beef and spices. Sprinkle on top of lettuce and top with crumbled melba toast.

title: Savory Beef Sausage
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground beef"1 tsp. paprika"1 tsp. sage"½ tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. ground fennel"½ tsp. pepper"¼ tsp. pink Himalayan salt"Pinch of red pepper flakes or cayenne pepper (Optional)
Body: Mix spices together in a large bowl. Add raw meat and mix thoroughly. Form into patty. Brown meat on stovetop until cooked through.

title: Meatloaf
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean ground beef/sirloin/buffalo"¼ Tbsp. onion powder"1 tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. sage"¼ tsp. oregano"¼ tsp. basil"¼ tsp. salt"Pepper to taste"One small chopped roma tomato"¼ chopped green onion
Body: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Combine all ingredients in bowl, mixing gently. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes or until done

title: Bok Choy Stir Fry
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean ground beef"1 tsp. coconut aminos (any flavor)"¾ tsp. ginger"1 tsp. of water or coconut aminos"3 Tbsp. of diced red onion"1 head of chopped bok choy
Body: Whisk together coconut aminos and ginger and set aside. In a large sauté pan, heat water and/or coconut aminos. Add onion, carrots and bok choy, cook until the onions are translucent and the bok choy is wilted. Transfer to a plate and set aside. In the same skillet cook the ground beef until browned. Add the vegetables back into the pan. Pour the stir fry sauce over top and toss.

title: Famous Chili
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean ground sirloin beef"1 c. chopped tomatoes"½ c. water"2 Tbsp. minced onion"½ cup chopped green or red bell peppers"2 cloves garlic, crushed and minced"Pinch of onion powder"¼ tsp. chili powder"pinch of oregano"Cayenne pepper, to taste"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Brown ground beef. Add onions, peppers, and garlic and sauté until softened. Stir in tomatoes and water. Add spices and simmer slowly. Salt and pepper to taste. The longer it cooks the more flavorful it becomes. Add water as needed

title: Balsamic Mustard-Crusted Steak
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz lean steak (filet, sirloin, London broil)"1 Tbsp. mustard powder"2 Tbsp. balsamic vinegar"¼ tsp. salt"½ tsp. freshly ground black pepper"1 Tbsp. garlic powder
Body: Line a broiler pan with foil and place steak on top. Mix all seasonings in a mixing bowl. Coat the steak evenly with mustard mixture and let stand 10 minutes. Place on broiler pan and broil steak to desired temperature. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing and serving

title: Wilted Baby Spinach Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. fresh baby spinach"¼ med. red onion sliced"¼ c. Apple cider vinegar"½ tsp. mustard powder"¼ tsp. garlic powder"¼ tsp. onion powder"Stevia to taste"Pepper to taste
Body: Toss spinach and onion together in bowl. Cover and chill in refrigerator. For dressing, add ingredients and heat the dressing until it starts to steam. Pour hot dressing over salad tossing gently to wilt greens.

title: Sautéed Cabbage
Recipe Ingredients: ½ small head cabbage"2 Tbsp. water"Juice of half lemon or 1 Tbsp. balsamic vinegar"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Place cabbage in skillet and sauté adding water a little at a time as needed to soften cabbage. Cover and steam for 5 to 10 minutes, until slightly tender. Add lemon juice or balsamic vinegar. Salt and pepper to taste. Place cabbage in a bowl and serve.

title: Cucumber Onion Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced"2 Tbsp. thinly sliced white onion"2 Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley or dill"2 Tbsp. white vinegar"2 tsp. soy sauce"Optional stevia to taste
Body: Combine ingredients and chill for 30-60 minutes

title: Crisp Radish Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. radishes, sliced"Juice from one lemon"1 Tbsp, dried minced onion"1 Tbsp. parsley"½ tsp. dill"½ tsp. celery seed"Salt and Pepper to taste
Body: In bowl, combine all ingredients and refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.

title: Asparagus Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"¼ tsp. dill"¼ tsp. mustard powder"¼ tsp. onion powder"¼ tsp. stevia"Salt and pepper to taste"4 oz. fresh asparagus"3 green onions, cut into ½ inch pieces
Body: Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl; set aside. Clean and snap off woody ends of asparagus and discard the woody ends. Cut stalks into ¼ inch slices. Place in a large salad bowl. Pour dressing over top; toss gently to coat. Cover and chill 1 hour before serving. Just before serving, finish with green onions to taste.

title: Roasted/Grilled Lemon Pepper Asparagus
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. asparagus"Lemon pepper seasoning"Himalayan salt to taste
Body: Clean and snap off woody ends of asparagus spears and discard. Place asparagus on baking sheet, grill, or air fryer oven. Sprinkle with salt and lemon-pepper seasoning. Cook until tender (10-15 minutes air fryer at 400 degrees) (15-20 minutes in oven at 350 degrees) (10-15 minutes on open grill until softened)

title: Lemon Swiss Chard
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. roughly chopped Swiss chard"1 small garlic clove"2 Tbsp. water"Juice from one lemon"Himalayan salt and pepper to taste
Body: Put 1 Tbsp. water in nonstick pan and sauté garlic until tender; set aside. Pour another 1 Tbsp. water into same pan and add Swiss chard. Add salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat for5-6 minutes, tossing occasionally while cooking. When greens have softened, transfer to a serving bowl. Splash with lemon juice just before serving.

title: Zucchini Basil Pasta Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. zucchini"1 Tbsp. minced garlic"1 medium tomato chopped"½ cup basil leaves, torn into pieces"2 tsp. cold water"Salt and pepper to taste
Body: Spiralize the zucchini and set aside. Add garlic to a skillet. On medium heat, add zucchini noodles. Sauté and toss the noodles with tongs and cook until slightly firm. Do not overcook. Stir in the tomatoes and basil cooking for another two minutes.. Toss some fresh chopped basil to finish just before serving.

title: Greens
Recipe Ingredients: 2 Tbsp. chicken bouillon base"4 oz. chopped greens any type"Pinch of onion salt"Salt and pepper to taste"Red pepper flakes to taste"Splash of Apple Cider Vinegar
Body: Heat bouillon base, on medium heat, just prior to boiling. Reduce heat. Add greens and sauté a few minutes until soft. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, onion powder, and red pepper flakes to taste. Finish with a splash of apple cider vinegar just prior to serving.

title: Garden Salad
Recipe Ingredients: ¼ head crisp iceberg lettuce or Boston lettuce"6 spinach leaves or mixed baby greens"3 thin, shredded slices radicchio"¼ red pepper, sliced"1 small tomato chopped"1 green onion, chopped"Pinch of dill weed, chopped"Fresh chopped parsley to taste
Body: Place ingredients in bowl and toss.

title: Apple Cider Vinegar Strawberry Spinach Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. baby spinach (mixed baby greens or lettuce)"¾ Tbsp. apple cider vinegarv"½ Tbsp. Dijon mustard"½ tsp. Orange zest"½ Tbsp. orange juice (from squeezed orange)"½ tsp. freshly grated ginger"Salt and Pepper to taste"2 oz thinly sliced strawberries
Body: Whisk ingredients except spinach and strawberries together and toss with baby spinach or mixed baby greens or any type of lettuce. Serve with thinly sliced strawberries.

title: Veggie Tossed Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 large head lettuce"1 chopped green pepper"1 large head lettuce"1 chopped red onion"1 chopped bundle celery"1 bundle chopped parsley"4 oz. radishes"1 chopped medium cucumber"1 Handful fresh mushrooms
Body: Toss chopped ingredients in salad bowl. Chill and serve with balsamic vinaigrette dressing (see recipe).

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 6 oz. chicken broth base (see recipe)"4 oz. cooked, chopped chicken"2 stalks of chopped celery"2 oz. chopped carrots"½ sweet onion chopped"2 cups chopped cabbage (add towards end)
Body: Combine, bring to a boil. Lower heat & simmer for 20 min. Use cooked rotisserie chicken from store to save time.

title: Tomato Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 1 c. chicken boullion base"1 large tomato"1 tsp. garlic powder"1/2 tsp. onion powder"1/2 tsp.  stevia"1/2 tsp. basil"Salt and Pepper to taste
Body: Puree tomatoes in blender and then cook over medium heat to a boil. Add remaining ingredients. Turn heat to low. Add bouillon. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Vidalia onion"1 c. beef broth"1 tsp. garlic power"1 tsp. pepper"2 pieces of melba toast
Body: Slice onion into wedges using an apple slicer to open the onion. Place in a baking dish. Season the onion and add ¼ c. beef broth and Place in a baking dish. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour. Make sure the onion is a little firm. Serve in a bowl with beef broth and Melba toast.

title: Chicken Broth Base
Recipe Ingredients: 6-4 oz. pieces of chicken"9 c. water"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. onion powder"1 Tbsp. Old Bay Seasoning"1 tsp. poultry seasoning"1 tsp. pepper"1 Tbsp. sea salt
Body: Combine ingredients in stock pot and cook until chicken is done, about 45 minutes. Take chicken out and save for other meals. Use broth for soups, and in other recipes. Freeze some of the broth in ice cube trays for sautéing later.

title: Sour Apple Tossed Salad
Recipe Ingredients: ½ head lettuce"1 unpeeled chopped tart apple"½ small red onion, sliced into rings"1 peeled and chopped cucumber
Body: In a large salad bowl, toss lettuce, apple slices, cucumber and onions.

title: Cucumber Apple Vinegar Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 chopped apple"1 sliced cucumber"2 Tbsp. apple cider vinegar"2 Tbsp. water"Juice of one lemon"Garlic salt"Salt and Pepper to taste"Stevia to taste
Body: Chop apple and thinly slice cucumber. Combine vinegar, water and lemon juice. Season with garlic salt, pepper and stevia to taste.

title: Berry Smoothie
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. partially frozen strawberries/mixed berries"1 tsp. stevia"Juice of one lemon"1/8 tsp. vanilla
Body: Blend until smooth (freeze for one hour to create a sorbet).

title: No Sugar Baked Apple
Recipe Ingredients: 1 apple, peeled"½ t ground cinnamon"Dash of ground clove"1 tsp. stevia
Body: Bake an apple and peel off skin and mash. Add cinnamon, clove and stevia and serve.

title: Cinnamon Strawberries
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 Tbsp. cinnamon"1 tsp. stevia"1 Tbsp. lemon juice
Body: Squeeze lemon juice over sliced strawberries. Mix cinnamon and Stevia and sprinkle over the strawberries

title: Cinnamon Strawberries
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 T cinnamon"1 t stevia"1 T lemon juice
Body: Squeeze lemon juice over sliced strawberries. Mix cinnamon and Stevia and sprinkle over the strawberries

title: Chicken Caccitore
Recipe Ingredients: 1 pound Chicken Breast"1 pound Cauliflower"2 cans Diced Tomatoes"1 can Sugar Free Tomato Sauce"2 cups Sliced Mushrooms"1 cup diced Red Onion"1 diced Bell Pepper"2 Packets Stevia"Minced Garlic"Oregano"Basil"Cilantro"Thyme"Sea or Himalayan Salt"Ground Pepper
Body:
Put cauliflower florettes in food processor and chop up to create a cauliflower rice consistancy. If you weren't able to find sugar free tomato sauce, used 1 can of diced tomatos and blend until it has the consistancy of tomato sauce.

Chop up the chicken into either individual 4 oz pieces if possible, or simply cut it up into fajita sized slices. Put all ingredients into a crock pot for 2 to 3 hours. I unfortunately have been making this for years and don't know the measurements of the spices, so you'll have to do that on your own according to your own taste.

This makes four services for you to use throughout the week.

title: Zucchini Spaghetti
Recipe Ingredients: 16 oz Zucchini"16 oz Ground Chicken Breast"2 cups Sliced Mushrooms"2 cans of Diced Tomatoes"1 can Sugar Free Tomato Sauce"1 diced Yellow Bell Pepper"1/2 cup diced Red Onion"Oregano"Minced Garlic"Thyme"Rosemary"1 Bay Leaf"Sea or Himalayan Salt"Ground Pepper"2 Packets of Stevia
Body:
Put all ingredients other than the zucchini into a crock pot and cook for 2 hours, or on a stove for about 20-30 minutes or until the mushrooms, onions and chicken are fully cooked. Each of the spices probably should be less than 1/2 a teaspoon, but will leave this up to your personal taste.

You can substitute lean ground beef or turkey breast for the ground chicken breast if you like.

Spiralize the zucchini and add it to the pot at the end just long enough to warm it. Putting the zucchini in at the beginning will over cook it. This recipe makes four servings. This freezes well and can be reheated for future meals.

title: Veggie Dressing
Recipe Ingredients: 1/4 c. vinegar"1/4 c. sliced green onions"1/4 c. minced freshly parsley"1 tbsp. chopped green pepper"1 tsp. salt"1 tsp. dry mustard"pinch of red pepper"1/2 tsp. soy sauce
Body:
Shake all ingredients well in a tightly covered jar.
Keep covered in refrigerator.
Makes 8 servings.

title: Spicy BBQ Sauce & Marinade
Recipe Ingredients: 2- 12 oz. jars of salsa (less than 1-gram per serving)"3/4 c. lemon juice"2 tbsp. Worcestershire sauce"5 tsp. Stevia"2 tsp. salt"4 tsp. chili powder"1/2 tsp. Tabasco sauce"garlic powder to taste
Body:
Combine and refrigerate.
Makes 24 servings.

title: No Sugar Strawberry Jam
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 c. cold water"4 tsp. Stevia
Body:
In a large saucepan, crush strawberries.
Add water and Stevia, mixing well.
Over medium heat bring mixture to boiling, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour into jars, allow to cool and then cover.

title: Strawberry Syrup
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"2 tbsp. water"3 tsp. Stevia
Body:
In microwave-safe bowl, combine all ingredients and toss.
Microwave for 2 to 3 minutes until berries soften.

title: Cocktail Sauce
Recipe Ingredients: 1 c. sugar-free tomato sauce"1/2 tsp. celery salt"1/4 tsp. paprika"1 tbsp. finely chopped sweet onion or shallot"4 tsp. Stevia powder"2 tbsp. fresh chopped parsley"1 tbsp. Worcestershire sauce"1 tbsp. fresh lemon juice"2 tbsp. drained, prepared horseradish"1/2 tsp. hot sauce"pinch of cumin"pinch of salt"pinch of freshly ground black pepper
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Fresh Salsa
Recipe Ingredients: 4-5 tomatoes"4 tbsp. lemon juice"3-4 tbsp. garlic, minced"1/2 chopped onion"1/2 tsp. chili powder"1/2 tsp. Italian seasoning"cayenne pepper to taste"cilantro (fresh or dried) to taste"salt and pepper
Body:
Put all the ingredients in the food processor.
Blend to desired consistency.
Refrigerate to blend the flavors.
The longer it sits the more flavor it will have.

title: Citrus Dressing
Recipe Ingredients: 1/4 apple cider vinegar"1 c. water"1 tbsp. lemon"1 tsp. Stevia"1/4 tsp. garlic powder
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Dill Dressing
Recipe Ingredients: 5 tbsp. apple cider vinegar"2 tbsp. water"2 tbsp. dried basil"2 tbsp. dried dill"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. dry mustard"1 tsp. onion powder
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Strawberry Vinaigrette
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1 tbsp. lemon juice"pinch of salt"pinch of cayenne (optional)"fresh ground black pepper to taste"Stevia to taste
Body:
Combine all ingredients in food processor.
Puree until smooth.
Pour over fresh arugula or green salad.
Garnish with sliced strawberries and freshly ground black pepper.
Variations: use as a marinade or sauce for chicken.

title: Balsamic Vinaigrette
Recipe Ingredients: 1/4 c. balsamic vinegar"2 tbsp. water"2 tbsp. dried thyme"1 tbsp. dried basil"1/4 tsp. garlic powder"salt and pepper to taste
Body: Add all ingredients in a blender and mix well.

title: Spicy Mustard Dressing
Recipe Ingredients: 1/2 bottle of apple cider vinegar"2 tsp. wasabi powder"2 tsp. dry mustard powder
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Smoky BBQ Sauce
Recipe Ingredients: 2 tbsp. sugar-free tomato sauce"1/2 tsp. dehydrated minced onion"1/2 tsp. red wine vinegar or apple cider vinegar"1/4 tsp. sugar-free liquid smoke"1/4 tsp. paprika"1/4 tsp. chili powder"pinch of cinnamon"pinch of cloves"Stevia if needed
Body:
In small non-stick saucepan, combine all ingredients and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Gravy
Recipe Ingredients: 1/2 c. homemade chicken broth (see recipe)"1 Grissini or 1 Melba Toast
Body:
Grind Grissini or Melba toast in food processor or blender.
Add 1/4 c. broth to small saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add powdered grissini/Melba to the pan, whisking constantly until dissolved.
Still whisking, add remaining 1.4 c. broth.
Reduce heat to medium and whisk for 3 to 4 minutes until thickened.
Season to taste.

title: Taco Seasoning
Recipe Ingredients: 1 tbsp. chili powder"2 tsp. onion powder"1 tsp. ground cumin"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. paprika"1 tsp. ground oregano

title: Simple Salad Dressing
Recipe Ingredients: 1/2 c. unfiltered apple cider vinegar"1/4 c. lemon juice"1 tbsp. water"plain or Valencia orange flavored Stevia
Body: Add to taste: salt, pepper, dried shallots, garlic powder, onion salt, chives, dried cilantro, parsley, basil, Stevia (plain or Valencia orange flavored).

title: Ginger Red Snapper
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. snapper"2 tbsp. fresh grated ginger"2 tbsp. balsamic vinegar"2 tbsp. distilled white vinegar"3 drops liquid Stevia"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. pepper"1 lemon wedge
Body:
Finely grate 1 tbsp. fresh ginger in small skillet.
Add the snapper and cover with water to reach 2 inches and bring to a simmer.
Season red snapper with grated ginger, lemon, salt, and pepper.
Place in steamer and cook for about 10 minutes.

title: Seafood Gumbo
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. seafood (any allowable combo)"1 garlic clove, chopped"2 large roma tomatoes, chopped"1/4 tsp. onion salt"1/4 tsp. Creole seasoning"pinch of garlic powder"pinch of celery salt"pinch of cayenne pepper"1-2 tsp. Stevia
Body:
Saute seafood with chopped garlic on high heat until browned.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer on low for 15 minutes.

title: Shrimp Ceviche
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. shrimp, fresh or frozen, raw or cooked, peeled"juice of 1 large lemon"juice of 1 large lime"1 tbsp. fresh garlic, minced"1 mild pepper, ribs and seeds removed, finely chopped"1/2 red onion, finely chopped"2 tbsp. Tabasco or hot sauce"2 large tomatoes"1 cucumber, peeled and diced into 1/2-inch pieces"1/4 c. fresh cilantro, chopped"1/4 c. fresh parsley, chopped"sea salt and fresh ground black pepper to taste
Body:
Thaw shrimp if frozen.
If using raw shrimp, bring a pot of water to boil and cook the shrimp for 1-2 minutes until it turns opaque. (do not overcook shrimp as it will become rubbery)
Rinse shrimp under cold water.
Combine juice of lemons and limes in a large glass bowl or large Ziploc bad and add shrimp.
Cover bowl or seal bag and refrigerate for 30 minutes to marinate.
Large shrimp could be cut into smaller chunks to speed up marinating process.
To shrimp, add Tabasco, garlic, onion, and pepper; mix evenly.
Refrigerate 30 additional minutes so the flavors infuse shrimp.
Before serving, place shrimp mixture in a bowl and toss with cilantro, parsley, tomatoes, and cucumbers.
If needed, add sea salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Spicy Steamed Shrimp
Recipe Ingredients: 1-quart water"4 oz. tiger pawns with shell"3 oz. Old Bay Seasoning"1 lemon, juiced
Body:
In a large pot, bring water to a boil.
Place shrimp in a steamer basket and place on top of the pot; cover.
Do not submerge shrimp.
Remove some water if necessary.
Season the shrimp with Old Bay Seasoning.
Steam shrimp until pink.

title: Rosemary Fish & Lemon Garlic Chard
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. halibut or tilapia"4 oz. asparagus"Italian Herb Seasoning"1 tsp. ground rosemary"1 tsp. ground pepper"2 drops Stevia"1 tsp. sea salt"fresh lemon juice"1 tsp. garlic salt
Body:
Sprinkle both sides of fish with spices.
Place fish on a nonstick frying pan with 1/4 cup water and lemon juice.
Add asparagus.
Place a lid on the pan to keep the steam within the pan.

title: Lemon Zest Crab Cakes
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. crab"1 garlic clove, minced"1 tbsp. onion powder"1/2 tsp. lemon zest"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. pepper"1 tsp. dry mustard"2 lemon wedges"1 tbsp. parsley"1 tsp. lemon zest
Body:
Mix ingredients together and make 2 small patties.
Place in a baking dish and bake for 15 minutes.
Place on serving dish.

title: Lemon Pepper Fish
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. whitefish"juice of half lemon"3 cloves minced garlic"1/2 tsp. black pepper"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. cumin powder"pinch of turmeric
Body:
Place fish in small bowl.
Add garlic, black pepper, salt, cumin, and turmeric.
Coat both sides.
Cover and marinate at least 1 hour in refrigerator.
Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Place fish in non-stick baking dish and cover with marinade.
Bake 10 to 20 minutes depending on thickness, until fish easily flakes.
Squeeze with lemon juice and serve.

title: Lemon Oregano Whitefish & Asparagus
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. whitefish"4 oz. asparagus"juice of one lemon"1 tsp. oregano"salt and pepper to taste
Body:
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.
Snap off woody ends of asparagus and discard.
Place asparagus spears on foil lined baking sheet and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place whitefish on top of asparagus.
In small bowl, combine lemon juice and oregano and pour over fish.
Fold up edges and completely seal packet on all sides.
Bake 10 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes.

title: Lemon Lime Tilapia
Recipe Ingredients: 14 oz. tilapia or any white fish"1/4 lemon sliced"1/4 lime sliced"1 garlic clove, minced"1/2 tsp. dry dill"1/4 c. water"sea salt and black pepper to taste
Body:
Mix together lemon juice, lime juice, garlic, salt, pepper, and dill.
Marinate fish in seasonings for 10 minutes and place in non-stick pan with water.
Cover and steam for 10 minutes.

title: Grilled Halibut with Garlic Cilantro Sauce
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. halibut fillet or steak"4 cloves garlic, finely minced"1 c. chicken bone broth no added sugar"2 tsp. lime zest (from 2 limes)"juice of 2 limes (2-3 tbsp. or more)"3 tbsp. finely chopped fresh cilantro
Body:
Saute garlic for about 2 minutes in chicken bone broth.
Add the remainder of broth and lime zest; let simmer about 10 minutes, until broth is slightly reduced.
Stir in lime juice and heat for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in cilantro and cook 1 minute more.
Brush fish on both sides with case and let marinate 15 minutes while you pre-heat grill to high heat.
Grill fish until firm to the touch, about 5 minutes per side.
To get nice grill marks, lay fish on a diagonal to grill slats, then rotate after about 3 minutes cooking time on the first side.
Serve fish hot with additional sauce spooned over each piece of fish.

title: Lemon Dill Swordfish
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. swordfish steaks"2 tbsp. lemon juice"1 tbsp. lemon pepper"1 tbsp. dried dill
Body:
Lightly oil outdoor grill grate with cooking spray and preheat for hight heat.
Place swordfish steaks in medium bowl, and brush with lemon juice.
Coat each side with lemon pepper and dill.
Place swordfish on the prepared grill, and cook 6 minutes on each side or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Citrus Shrimp & Greens
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. shrimp"2 tsp. lemon juice"1 tbsp. lime juice"3 tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. pepper"1/2 tsp. onion salt
Body:
Place in a bowl, mix together all ingredients and let it stand.
Marinate for 1/2 hour.
You can either grill the shrimp on a grill or in a non-stick frying pan.
Serve over your favorite salad greens.

title: Garlic Lemon Scallops or Shrimp
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. scallops or shrimp"1 tbsp. lemon juice"1 clove garlic, minced"lemon pepper to taste
Body:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Pat scallops dry with paper towels and place in a quart casserole dish.
Bake scallops in preheated oven for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine lemon juice and garlic.
Remove scallops from oven.
Spoon lemon/garlic mixture over scallops and sprinkle generously with lemon pepper.
Return scallops to oven and bake until firm, about 10 minutes.
Serve warm.

title: Citrus Orange Roughy
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. orange roughy"1/4 orange, juiced"1/4 lemon, juiced"1/4 tsp. lemon pepper"pinch of cayenne pepper
Body:
Warm non-stick skillet medium-high heat.
Arrange the fillets in the skillet and drizzle with orange juice and lemon juice.
Sprinkle with lemon pepper.
Cook for 5 minutes.

title: Spicy Red Sauce with Shrimp and Scallops
Recipe Ingredients: 2 oz. small shrimp, peeled and deveined"2 oz. bay scallops"2 cloves garlic, crushed"1 c. whole peeled tomatoes with liquid, chopped"1/2 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. crushed red pepper flakes"1/4 tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
Body:
Saute garlic over medium heat in non-stick skillet.
When the garlic starts to sizzle, pour in the tomatoes.
Season with salt and red pepper.
Bring to a boil.
Lower the heat, simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Lightly coat a large skillet with cooking spray and add the shrimp and scallops.
Cook for about 2 minutes, stirring frequently or until the shrimp turn pink.
Add shrimp ad scallops to the tomato mixture, and stir in parsley.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until the sauce just begins to bubble.
Serve.

title: Citrus Mahi Mahi
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. Mahi"1 tbsp. fresh lemon juice"1 tbsp. fresh lime juice"1 garlic clove, minced"1/2 tsp. dried thyme"1/2 tsp. dried dill"1/4 tsp. pepper"1/4 tsp. salt
Body:
Mix together lemon juice, lime juice, garlic, thyme, and salt and pepper to taste.
Place in a shallow dish, to coat and marinate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Heat grill pan or grill over medium heat.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side.

title: Citrus Fish
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. white fish"1 tbsp. minced onion"2 tbsp. lemon juice"lemon and orange zest to taste"lemon and orange slices"chopped parsley"salt and pepper to taste"Stevia to taste
Body:
Mix lemon juice with zest and a little Stevia.
Baste fish with mixture and top with salt, pepper, lemon and orange slices.
Wrap in aluminum foil and place on the BBQ or in oven at 350 degrees.
Cook fish for 5 o 10 minutes or until fish is thoroughly cooked.
Serve with lemon and top with parsley.

title: Apple Tilapia Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1/2 med. head lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces"4 oz. diced apple, unpeeled"1 tsp. soy sauce"4 oz. cooked tilapia"1/2 tsp. lemon juice"1/4 orange, juiced
Body:
In a large bowl, combine salad ingredients.
Toss together.
Combine soy sauce, orange juice, and lemon juice.
Mix well.
Toss with salad.

title: Chinese Steamed Fish
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. red snapper fillet"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. ground black pepper"1/2 tbsp. grated fresh ginger"1/2 tsp. soy sauce"2 shiitake mushrooms, thinly sliced"1/2 tomato, quartered"1/4 fresh red chili pepper, seeded and chopped"1 sprig cilantro, finely chopped
Body:
Bring about 1/2 inches of water to boil in a steam fitted with a basket large enough for the snapper to lie flat.
Season snapper with salt and pepper; place in the steamer basket.
Top fish with ginger, and drizzle with soy sauce.
Place shiitake mushrooms, tomato, and red chili pepper in the steamer basket.
Steam fish 15 minutes, or until easily flaked with a fork.
Sprinkle with cilantro.
Do no exceed soy sauce measurement.

title: Chilean Sea Bass
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. sea bass fillets"2 cloves garlic, minced"1/2 tsp. salt"1/2 tsp. lemon pepper"2 tbsp. finely chopped cilantro"1/2 tsp. paprika
Body:
Arrange sea bass fillets in a single layer on foil-lined broiler pan.
Spread garlic and cilantro on and around fish.
Squeeze lemon juice on fillets, sprinkle salt and lemon pepper to taste.
Add paprika for color.
Cover with foil and crimp edges to form a seal.
Bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes.

title: Cajun Style Tilapia
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. tilapia fillet"Cajun seasoning"lemon, thin slices"salt and pepper to taste
Body:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Line cookie sheet with foil.
Place tilapia fillets on cookie sheet and season with salt, pepper, and Cajun seasoning.
Top with lemon slices.
Bake in oven for 15 minutes or until fish is easily flaked with a fork.

title: Spicy Cajun Scallops
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. scallops or shrimp"1 lemon"1/2 tsp. dry mustard"1 tsp. pepper flakes"2 garlic cloves, minced"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. pepper"1/4 tsp. ground cayenne pepper"1/2 c. water
Body:
Mix together lemon juice, dry mustard, cayenne, garlic, salt, pepper, and scallops or shrimp.
Fill a non-stick frying pan with water and place mixture plus scallops or shrimp in pan.
Simmer by covering with lid for 10 minutes.

title: Really Easy Chowder
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. frozen tilapia, halibut, or other white fish"4 oz. diced tomatoes"1 1/2 stalks celery, chopped"1/2 tsp. dried oregano"1/2 tsp. dried basil"salt and pepper to taste
Body:
In a medium-sized stock pot, place undrained tomatoes, celery, oregano, basil, salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil over medium heat.
Place frozen fish fillets in pot.
Reduce heat and cook for 10 to 15 minutes.
Cook until mixture is heated through and fish is opaque and flaky.

title: Fried Chicken Tenders
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken"1 tbsp. water"1 Grissini bread stick or 4 Melba toast snacks"seasonings (salt, pepper, paprika, ground red pepper, garlic powder)
Body:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Slice chicken breast into 3 tenders.
Grind breadstick in food processor until it is a powder.
Put Grissini powder in a separate small bowl.
Dip chicken into water then dredge in Grissini powder and seasonings.
Place chicken in glass baking dish and back 30 to 40 minutes, turning over halfway through.
During last 5 minutes, turn on broiler and broil 2 to 3 minutes on each side.

title: Garlic Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken"diced onion"3 cloves garlic, unpeeled & left whole"juice of half lemon"black pepper to taste
Body:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Heat a non-stick saucepan.
Add onions.
Stir constantly for 5 to soften.
Transfer onions to glass baking dish, and place chicken on onions.
Squeeze lemon juice on chicken and onions; sprinkle with pepper.
Place garlic around and on the chicken.
Cover tightly with lid or aluminum foil.
Cook for 30 to 45 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink.

title: Orange Ginger Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken, cut into chunks"black pepper"1 orange, cut in 4 pieces"2-3 cloves garlic, minced"1/2 tsp. basil"1 tbsp. fresh ginger root (peeled and minced)"juice of half lemon
Body:
Preheat pan over medium heat.
Sprinkle chicken with pepper.
Add chicken to pan and stir fry until brown on all sides, about 5 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Squeeze juice of orange quarters over chicken.
Peel and separate orange into sections.
Add orange sections, ginger, lemon juice and basil.
Stir well.
Cover and simmer for about 20 to 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Taco Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 2 c. chopped romaine lettuce"4 oz. ground chicken or turkey"1/2 tsp. garlic salt"1/4 tsp. chili seasoning"crumbled Melba toast
Body:
Saute ground beef and spices.
Sprinkle on top of lettuce.
Top with crumbled Melba toast.

title: Chicken Breast Piccata
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless, skinless chicken breasts"1/2 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. black pepper"1/4 c. wine vinegar"2 tbsp. capers, drained"1/4 c. fresh lemon juice"3 tbsp. chopped fresh parsley"4 thin slices lemon, for garnish"4 thin slices lime, for garnish
Body:
Bone and skin chicken breasts.
Cut each into 2 pieces, cutting crosswise so that each piece is 2 to 3 inches square.
Place between sheets of plastic wrap.
With flat side of mallet, pound to about 1/4 inch thickness and double the diameter.
Lightly spray Pam in skillet.
Add chicken.
Sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Brown quickly on both sides, to cook meat through.
Remove onto warm platter.
Add wine vinegar, capers and lemon juice to pan.
Heat sauce to a boil, scraping bottom of pan.
When about 4 tablespoons liquid remains, pour it over chicken on platter.
Sprinkle with parsley.
Garnish with lemon and lime slices.
Serve immediately.

title: Cornish Hens
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. Cornish game hen"bay leaf"1 c. diced celery"1 c. diced onions"1/2 tsp. parsley flakes"1/4 tsp. thyme leaves
Body:
Season birds with salt and pepper, add 1 bay leaf in each cavity.
Truss for roasting.
Arrange vegetables in roasting pan.
Place bird, breast side up, on vegetables.
Combine herbs and brush over birds.
Roast in 375 degree oven 55 to 65 minutes or until tender, basting with juices.

title: Midwest American Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless, skinless chicken breast"1/2 tsp. ground ginger"1 tbsp. crushed garlic"1/2 tsp. ground turmeric
Body:
In a large bowl, combine ginger, garlic, turmeric, salt.
Marinate the chicken pieces in the mixture for 3 hours.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil grate.
Grill chicken until juices run clear.

title: Strawberry Chicken Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 2 c. of lettuce"4 oz. chicken"4 oz. strawberries, sliced"Sweet N Sour Vinaigrette Dressing or Salad Spritzer
Body:
Cook chicken.
Slice into bite-sized pieces.
Put lettuce in bowl with sliced strawberries, put chicken in and toss.
Drizzle with Sweet N sour Vinaigrette, salt, pepper, and herbs as desired.
Toss till lettuce is coated.

title: Herb-Smoked Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: Wood chips, soaked 1 hour"1 (3lb.) broiler-fryers"3 bunches various fresh herbs, untrimmed"freshly ground pepper
Body:
Prepare charcoal fire in smoker.
Scatter wood chips over coals.
Place water pan in smoker, and fill with water, wine, or fruit juice.
Stuff each fryer with 1 bunch of herbs, including stems and leaves.
Rub pepper liberally on surface of chickens, and place them on grill rack.
Inset meat thermometer, making sure it does not touch bone.
Cover with smoker lid; cook 3 1/2 to 4 1/2 hours or until thermometer reaches 185 degrees.
Refill the water pan and add charcoal as needed.

*NOTE:ONLY CONSUME 4 OZ. OF BREAST MEAT PER MEAL.

title: Tomato Basil Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken"1 c. chopped tomato"1/4 c. water or chicken broth"2 tbsp. lemon juice"2 tbsp. chopped onion"1 to 2 cloves garlic, sliced"3 leaves basil, rolled and sliced"pinch of oregano, fresh or dried"1/4 tsp. garlic powder"1/4 tsp. onion powder"salt and pepper to taste
Body:
Lightly brown the chicken in small saucepan with lemon juice.
Add garlic, onion, spices, and water.
After chicken is cooked, add fresh tomatoes and basil.
Continue cooking for 5 to 10 minutes.
Add salt and pepper to taste; garnish with fresh basil.

title: Lemon Parsley Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. skinless, boneless chicken breast"1/4 c. lemon juice"1/4 tsp. onion powder"pinch of ground cayenne pepper"ground black pepper to taste"2 tsp. dried parsley
Body:
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Dip chicken in lemon juice and sprinkle with onion powder, ground black pepper, seasoning salt, and parsley.
Discard any remaining lemon juice.
Cook on the grill 10 to 15 minutes per side, or until no longer pink.

title: Spicy Chicken Breasts
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless, skinless chicken breast"1 1/2 tsp. paprika"1 tsp. garlic powder"1/2 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. onion powder"1/4 tsp. dried thyme"1/4 tsp. ground cayenne pepper"1/4 tsp. ground black pepper
Body:
In a medium bowl, mix together the paprika, garlic powder, salt, onion powder, thyme, cayenne pepper, and ground black pepper.
Set aside about 3 tbsp. of this seasoning mixture for the chicken; store the remainder in an airtight container for later use (for seasoning fish, meats, or vegetables).
Lightly oil the grill grate with cooking spray.
Preheat grill for medium-high heat.
Rub some of the reserved 3 tbsp. seasoning onto both sides of the chicken breasts.
Place chicken on the grill; cook for 6 to 8 minutes on each side, until juices run clear.

title: Egg Rolls
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken or shrimp"2 to 3 big cabbage leaves"1 c. shredded cabbage"pinch of onion salt"pinch of garlic powder"pinch of Asian spices"Stevia to taste
Body:
Steam big cabbage leaves for 5 minutes.
Move leaves over to side of steamer to make room for shredded cabbage.
Steam both for 5 additional minutes.
Removed shredded cabbage to a mixing bowl.
Add chopped chicken or shrimp and spices.
Mix and then wrap in a big cabbage leaf.

title: Chipotle Lime Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken"1/4 c. fresh lime juice"1 tsp. fresh lime zest"1/4 c. chicken broth (no added sugar)"3 tbsp. fresh cilantro leaves (finely chopped)"1/2 jalapeno (finely chopped)"1 tsp. chipotle chili powder"2 garlic cloves (minced)"1/2 tsp. pink salt, or more to taste
Body:
Whisk all ingredients together and marinade chicken for at least 2 hours.
When ready to cook, remove chicken from marinade and grill on the BBQ or bake in oven at 350 degrees.
Serve 4 oz. of chicken as lettuce wraps with additional cilantro and lime wedges or over riced cauliflower.

title: Chicken or Turkey Burger
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground chicken or turkey breast"1/4 tsp. pepper"1/4 tsp. onion salt"1/4 tsp. onion powder"1/4 tsp. garlic powder"1/4 tsp. dry mustard"2 tbsp. cider"2 c. spinach
Body:
To the ground chicken breast, mix in the next 5 ingredients and mold into a small patty.
Grill or broil and serve with spinach and cider.

title: Braised Balsamic Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken breast"ground black pepper to taste"1/2 tsp. garlic salt"1/2 onion, thinly sliced"1/4 c. balsamic vinegar"1/4 c. apple cider vinegar"1 (16.5 oz) can diced tomatoes"1/2 tsp. dried basil"1/2 tsp. dried oregano"1/2 tsp. dried rosemary"1/2 tsp. dried thyme
Body: Season chicken breasts with ground black pepper and garlic salt. Lightly coat skillet with cooking spray and brown onion and seasoned chicken breasts. Pour tomatoes and vinegars over chicken. Season with basil, oregano, rosemary, and thyme. Simmer until chicken is no longer pink, about 15 minutes.

title: Chicken Chili
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken breast, pre-cooked"shredded cabbage"2 c. chicken broth"1 tsp. cayenne pepper"1 tsp. black pepper"1 tbsp. chili powder"1 tbsp. cumin"2 tsp. minced onions
Body:
In a medium saucepan, add chicken broth.
Bring to boil.
Add spices, cabbage, and cooked chicken.
Stir constantly.
Let simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Roasted Tarragon Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 2 tbsp. cup finely chopped tarragon (leaves and stems)"1 garlic cloves, finely grated or minced"1 tsp. pink salt, more as needed"1/2 tsp. ground black pepper, more as needed"1 bone-in chicken breast"2 large onions, peeled and sliced (about 1 cup)"1 thyme sprig"sherry vinegar, to taste
Body:
In a large bowl, stir together tarragon, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken and toss to coat.
Cover with plastic wrap and chill for at least 6 hours.
Heat oven to 425 degrees .
Spread onions out on a rimmed baking sheet, sprinkle with salt and pepper; toss.
Place chicken in baking sheet with onion surrounding.
Strew thyme sprig and tarragon over onions and chicken.
Roast until chicken is cooked through, 25 to 25 minutes.
Toss the onions after 15 minutes.
Place pan under the broiler for 1 to 2 minutes at the end of cooking.
Drizzle onions with sherry vinegar and salt and pepper if needed.

title: Cream of Chicken Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. cooked chicken"celery"3 cloves garlic"1-2 c. broth"1 tbsp. dehydrated minced onion"1/2 tsp. parsley"1/2 tsp. basil"freshly ground white pepper to taste"salt (optional)
Body:
Preheat saucepan over medium-high heat.
In food processor, combine all ingredients and pulse until they reach desired consistency.
Pour into saucepan and bring to boil.
Reduce heat to simmer, cover and heat 20 minutes.

title: Blackened Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless chicken breast, halved"1/4 tsp. paprika"pinch of salt"1/4 tsp. cayenne pepper"1/4 tsp. ground cumin"1/4 tsp. dried thyme"pinch of ground white pepper"pinch of onion powder
Body:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees
Heat skillet over high heat for 5 minutes until hot
Mix together paprika, salt, cayenne, cumin, thyme, white pepper, and onion powder
Coat the chicken breasts evenly with the spice mixture
Place the chicken in the hot pan; cook for 1 minute
Turn, and cook 1 minute on other side
Place the breasts on the sheet
Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, about 5 minutes

title: Curry Chicken and Spinach
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless, skinless chicken breast"2 c. spinach"2 tsp. onion powder"1 garlic clove (minced)"1/2 c. chicken broth"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. pepper"juice of 1 lime"1/2 tbsp. curry powder
Body:
Mix chicken, all seasonings, and 1/2 the lime juice
Cook chicken through
Add spinach for 1 minute and serve in a bowl
Squeeze the other 1/2 of the lime juice over the mixture

title: Roast Chicken & Veggies
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken breasts, chopped"1/2 c. bell pepper, chopped (any colors you like)"1/4 onion, chopped"1/2 zucchini, chopped"1/4 c. broccoli florets"1/4 c. tomatoes, chopped"1 1/2 tbsp. Bragg amino or coconut amino"1/2 tsp. pink salt"1/2 tsp. black pepper"1/2 tsp. Italian seasoning"1/4 tsp. paprika (optional)
Body:
Preheat oven to 500 degrees
Chop all the veggies into large pieces and the chicken into cubes
Place the chicken and veggies in a medium roasting dish
Add the amino, salt and pepper, Italian seasoning, and paprika
Toss to combine
Bake for 15 minutes or until the veggies are charred and chicken is cooked

title: Basil Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless chicken breast, cooked and cubed"1/4 c. finely chopped onion"1  clove garlic, chopped"2 1/2 c. chopped tomatoes"1/4 c. chopped fresh basil"1/2 tsp. salt"pinch of hot pepper flakes
Body:
Warm large skillet to medium-high heat
Saute the onions and garlic
Stir in the tomatoes, chicken, basil, salt, and hot pepper sauce
Reduce heat to medium
Cover skillet for about 5 minutes; stirring frequently, until mixture is hot and tomatoes are soft

title: Boneless Buffalo Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless, skinless chicken breasts (cut in half lengthwise and then into thirds horizontally into 3 cubes)"1 1/2 c. water or organic chicken broth, or a combination"cayenne pepper"garlic powder"salt"chili powder"Frank's Red-Hot Sauce
Body:
In a bowl, combine water/chicken broth, cayenne pepper, garlic powder, and sea salt
Pour into a large plastic bag along with cubed chicken; refrigerate 1-2 hours
Preheat oven to 350 degrees
Pout chili powder onto a plate and dip the chicken into the chili powder
Place on a rack on top of a casserole dish allowing chicken drippings to fall into the dish as it bakes to keep crisp
Bake 15-20 min, turning halfway through
Top with Frank's Red-Hot Sauce
Serve with celery sticks or atop a bed of chopped romaine lettuce

title: Salsa Chicken
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. skinless, boneless chicken breasts"1/2 c. salsa
Body:
Add chicken breasts to salsa and bring to a steady boil
Boil gently for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is no longer pink inside and juices run clear

title: Vinaigrette Dressing
Recipe Ingredients: 1/4 c. apple cider vinegar"1/2 c. water"1 tsp. celery salt"1 tsp. onion salt"1 tsp. pepper"1 tsp. Stevia
Body:
Mix all seasonings together and roll chicken in mixture until coated
Place on a foil sheet and wrap tightly
Put on cookie sheet and back at 375 degrees for 20-30 minutes
Slice chicken and put on bed of spinach or lettuce
Drizzle with Vinaigrette Dressing

title: Oven Chicken Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. boneless skinless chicken breast"1/4 tsp. cayenne pepper (optional)"1/4 tsp. onion powder"salt"pepper"1/4 tsp. garlic powder"1/4 tsp. poultry season"1 c. spinach or lettuce

title: Apple Chicken Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken, cooked and diced"1 apple, diced"3 stalks celery, diced"3 tbsp. lemon juice"pinch of cinnamon"pinch of nutmeg"pinch of cardamom"pinch of salt"Stevia to taste"lemon wedge
Body:
Mix ingredients together
Sprinkle with Stevia and cinnamon
Chill for 20 minutes before serving

title: Turkey Sausage Spinach
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground turkey"1 (10oz.) box frozen chopped spinach or 4 oz. fresh"1/2 c. water"1/4 tsp. minced garlic flakes or fresh"1/4 tsp. minced onion flakes"1/2 tsp. sage"1/4 tsp. thyme"1/4 tsp. fennel"pinch of cinnamon"pinch of nutmeg and cayenne"pink salt and pepper, to taste"1 dropperful SweetLeaf English Toffee Stevia
Body:
Cook turkey in skillet until beginning to brown; set aside
Add water to skillet and bring to a boil
Add spinach to skillet then cover
Reduce heat; Simmer for 10 minutes or until water is almost gone
Stir in all spices, Stevia, and turkey
Cook another 5 minutes

title: Apple Cider Wraps
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. chicken"2 medium green cabbage leaves"2 medium red (Napa) cabbage leaves"1 garlic clove"3 tbsp. cider"1/4 tsp. onion powder"1/4 tbsp. sea salt"1/4 tbsp. pepper"1 tbsp. fresh ginger
Body:
Mix together finely grated ginger, garlic, onion powder, cider, salt, pepper, and chicken pieces.
Cook until chicken is cooked thoroughly and then add the Napa cabbage.
Cook until cabbage is slightly cooked.
Take the 2 green cabbage leaves and split the chicken mixture.
Please in cabbage leaves and roll into a wrap.

title: Taco Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 2 c. chopped romaine lettuce"4 oz. lean ground beef"1/2 tsp. garlic salt"1/4 tsp. chili seasoning"crumbled Melba toast
Body:
Saute ground beef and spices.
Sprinkle on top of lettuce and top with crumbled Melba toast.

title: Flank Steak Spinach Rolls
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. flank steak"baby spinach"1 clove garlic"1 tbsp. flat leaf parsley"chicken broth (no added sugar)"nutmeg"pink sea salt"ground black pepper
Body:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Pound flank steak until 1/4-1/2" thick.
Salt and pepper both sides.
In a food processor, puree spinach, garlic, and parsley with just enough chicken broth to create a paste.
Spread paste on one side of the flank steak.
Sprinkle nutmeg sparingly.
Roll up flank stead and use toothpicks to secure.
Make sure to roll it so the fibers are lengthwise so that when you cut into it, it will be against the grain.
Insert meat thermometer.
Place face down in pan and bake until meat thermometer reaches 160 degrees (for medium doneness).

title: Beef Sausage
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground beef"1 tsp. paprika"1/2 tsp. minced garlic"1/4 tsp. ground fennel"1/2 tsp. pepper"1/2 tsp. pink salt"pinch of red pepper flakes"pinch of cayenne pepper
Body:
Mix spices together in a large bowl.
Add meat and mix thoroughly.
Form into patty.
Brown meat on stovetop until cooked through.

title: Mongolian Beef
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. beef sirloin tips thin sliced against the grain"2 tsp. coconut aminos"1/2 tsp. Red Boat fish sauce"1 large clove garlic finely minced"2-inch long thinly sliced ginger"1 red chili peppers. Remove seeds, slice to thin strips"1 scallion bulbs cut into 3-inch length
Body:
Thinly slice beef against the grain.
Add coconut aminos and fish sauce.
Marinate the beef for 20 minutes.
Spray pan lightly with cooking spray.
When hot, lower the heat to medium.
Stir-fry the beef with the marinade until no longer pink.
Set aside.
Add more cooking spray, saute the ginger, garlic, red chili peppers, and scallions under medium to medium-high heat until fragrant.
Season with a small pinch of salt.
Add beef and green portions of scallions back to the saute pan.
Toss to combine.

title: Cucumber Dill Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 6 oz. cucumber"1 tbsp. vinegar"1 tsp. dill"Stevia"black pepper"pink salt
Body:
Slice and quarter cucumber.
Place vinegar, dill, Stevia, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Stir in cucumber.

title: Mini Meatloaf & Cucumber Dill Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean ground beef (or buffalo)"1/4 tbsp. onion powder"1 cloves garlic, minced"1/4 tsp. sage"1/4 tsp. oregano"1/4 tsp. basil"1/4 tsp. marjoram"1/4 tsp. salt"pepper
Body:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cover baking sheet with foil. Combine all ingredients in bowl, mixing gently.
Divide into 4 servings and shape into mini loaves.
Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes or until done.

title: Bok Choy Stir Fry
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean ground beef"1 tsp. coconut aminos (any flavor)"3/4 tsp. ginger"1 tsp. of water or coconut aminos"3 tbsp. red onion (diced)"1  head bok choy (chopped)
Body:
Whisk together coconut aminos and ginger; set aside.
In a large saute pan, heat water and/or coconut aminos.
Add onions, carrots, and bok choy.
Cook until the onions are translucent and the bok choy is wilted.
Transfer to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the ground beef until browned.
Add the vegetables back into the pan.
Pour the stir fry cause over top and toss.

title: BBQ Beef Pepper Popper
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. ground beef"4 oz. diced bell peppers"1 tbsp. Simple Girl Carolina Style BBQ Sauce"1/2 tbsp. Simple Girl Sweet Mustard Dressing (or 1/2 tbsp. yellow mustard and Stevia, to taste)
Body:
Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Line baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine all ingredients together in small bowl with hands.
Scoop mixture out by spoonful into 6 mounds onto lined pan, flatten slightly if desired.
Bake 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
If desired, place under the broiler for an additional 2-3 minutes or until browned.

title: Rosemary Balsamic Sauce
Recipe Ingredients: 1 large clove garlic, minced"1/4 c. dark balsamic vinegar"2 tbsp. dry red wine"Stevia to taste"2 sprigs fresh rosemary"1/4 c. beef bone broth or mushroom broth
Body:
Heat sauce pan to medium heat.
Add garlic and a little water; cook for 1 minute.
Add balsamic vinegar, red wine, Stevia, and rosemary sprigs.
Bring to rapid boil.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes.
Add broth, return to boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for another 15 minutes.
Discard rosemary sprigs.

title: Balsamic Steak Rolls
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. thin sliced sirloin or flank steak"pink salt and freshly ground black pepper"1 fresh rosemary, chopped"1 red bell pepper, sliced into thin strips"4 oz. zucchini, sliced into thin strips"1 med. yellow or red onion, thinly sliced"white button or cremini mushrooms, cut into thin strips
Body:
Sprinkle with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and chopped fresh rosemary.
Heat skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the vegetables until crisp-tender, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Place vegetable strips vertically on one end of each steak cutlet so that once rolled up, the end of the vegetables stick out of each end of the steak roll.
Roll and secure with a toothpick.
Repeat for each steak roll.
Grill about 2 minutes on each side or according to desired doneness or cook them in a skillet, frying over medium-high heat until done.
Drizzle with rosemary balsamic sauce.

title: Marinated London Broil Salsa
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. London broil"2 1/2 tbsp. balsamic vinegar"2 1/2 tbsp. distilled white vinegar"2 tbsp. dried oregano"3 tbsp. garlic powder"1/4 tsp. salt"1/4 tsp. pepper"2 c. dried tomatoes
Body:
Marinate London broil with all seasonings for 1 hour.
Season diced tomatoes and place in the middle of the plate.
Broil or grill steak to your temperature.
Place on top of salsa.

title: Filet Mignon Braised Cabbage
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. filet mignon"1 c. cabbage, shredded"cider vinegar"lemon pepper"1-2 tsp. or 6-8 drops Stevia"rosemary leaves
Body:
Cook filet mignon in a stovetop grill pan.
Drizzle a little vinegar and lemon pepper on top.
Sprinkle a few rosemary leaves before grilling.
Make sure to not overcook.
Slice thinly.
Put cabbage in a small saucepan with enough water to allow to braise.
Add vinegar, lemon pepper, and a teaspoon or two of Stevia to sweeten.
Turn the cabbage often to cook evenly.

title: Chili
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. lean ground beef"1 c. chopped tomatoes"1/2 c. water"2 tbsp. minced onion"2 cloves garlic, crushed and minced"pinch of garlic powder"pinch of onion powder"1/4 tsp. chili powder"pinch of oregano"cayenne pepper, to taste (optional)"salt and pepper to taste
Body:
Brown ground beef in small frying pan; add onions and garlic.
Stir in tomatoes and water.
Add spices and simmer slowly until liquid is reduced.
The longer it cooks, the more tender and flavorful it becomes.
Add water as needed.
Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Balsamic Mustard-Crusted Steak
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. filet or London broil"1 tsp. mustard powder"2 tsp. balsamic vinegar"1/4 tsp. salt"1/2 tsp. freshly ground black pepper"2 garlic cloves, minced
Body:
Mix all seasonings in a mixing bowl. Line a broiler pan with foil and place steak on top.
Coat evenly with mustard mixture and let stand 10 minutes.
Broil steak to desired temperature.
Let stand 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Citrus Tomato Salsa
Recipe Ingredients: 1 large chopped tomato"1 tbsp. fresh lemon juice"pinch of celery salt"pinch of chili powder"Stevia to taste"1 tsp. fresh cilantro"1/4 c. dressing (see recipe)
Body: Combine and refrigerate.

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 6 c. chicken broth base (see recipe)"4 oz. chicken, cooked and chopped"2 stalks of chopped celery"1 whole sweet onion chopped"2 handfuls chopped cabbage"1 med-sized chopped tomato (optional)
Body:
Combine and bring to a boil.
Turn heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender, adding cabbage for the last 10 minutes.

title: Steamed Cabbage
Recipe Ingredients: 1/2 small head cabbage"juice of half lemon"1/2 tsp. spicy mustard"salt and pepper to taste
Body:
Place cabbage in steamer.
Cover and steam 5 to 10 minutes, until slightly tender.
In a small bowl combine spicy mustard and lemon juice.
Place cabbage in a bowl.
Add lemon/mustard mix and toss.
Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Cucumber Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. cucumber, thinly sliced"2 tbsp. finely chopped onion"2 tbsp. chopped parsley"1 tbsp. white vinegar"1 tsp. soy sauce
Body: Combine ingredients and chill for 30 minutes.

title: Radish Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. radishes, sliced"lemon juice"1 tbsp. dehydrated minced onion"1 tbsp. parsley"salt and pepper to taste
Body: In bowl, combine all ingredients and refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour before serving.

title: Asparagus Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. fresh asparagus"1 tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1/4 tsp. celery seeds"1/4 tsp. dry mustard"salt and pepper to taste"3 green onions, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
Body:
Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl; set aside.
Trim asparagus and remove tough ends of stalks.
Cut stalks into 1/4-inch slices.
Cut remaining tips; place in a large salad bowl.
Add remaining ingredients.
Pour dressing over top; toss gently to coat.
Cover and chill 1 hour before serving.

title: Lemon Ginger Asparagus
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. asparagus"1/4 c. water"1/4 tbsp. fresh minced ginger root"1 clove minced garlic"lemon zest"black pepper
Body:
Preheat pan over medium heat.
Snap off woody ends of asparagus spears and discard.
Cut spears into 2 or 3 pieces.
Add garlic and ginger to the pan.
Saute for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add asparagus and water.
Bring to a boil for 5 minutes.
Remove asparagus and top with lemon zest and pepper.

title: Lemon Garlic Chard
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. roughly chopped Swiss chard"1 small garlic clove"2 tsp. water"lemon juice"sea salt"pepper
Body:
Put 1 tsp. water in non-stick pan and saute garlic until tender; set aside.
Pour remaining water into pan and add chard.
Cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes, tossing occasionally.
Drain off excess juice and return to pan adding in sauteed garlic.
Before serving, top with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

title: Garlic Zucchini Pasta Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. zucchini"1 tbsp. minced garlic"1/4 tsp. crushed red pepper flakes"1/2 tsp. Xanthium gum"1 med. tomato, chopped"1/2 c. basil leaves, torn into pieces"2 tsp. cold water"salt and pepper to taste
Body:
Spiralize the zucchini about the length of spaghetti.
On medium heat, add garlic and red pepper flakes to a deep skillet.
When oil bubbles, add zucchini noodles.
Toss the noddles with pasta tongs and cook until al dente.
Do not overcook noddles. Transfer noodles, tomatoes, and basil to a serving dish.
Leave the liquid in the skillet and simmer.
Combine Xanthium Gum and cold water in a small bowl then whisk into the simmering liquid.
Cook, while whisking, until liquid thickens to a sauce; about 1 minute.
Taste the sauce and season with pink salt.
Pour the sauce over the zucchini, tomatoes, and basil.

title: Stewed Tomatoes
Recipe Ingredients: 3 medium red tomatoes"2 tsp. salt
Body:
Peel tomatoes and place in boiling water for 1 minute.
Immediately transfer to cold water.
Peel and quarter tomatoes.
Place in large saucepan with salt.
Simmer over low heat for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent burning.

title: Greens or Asparagus
Recipe Ingredients: 2 tbsp. chicken bouillon base"4 oz. chopped beet greens or asparagus"pinch of onion salt
Body:
Heat bouillon base, on medium heat, prior to boiling.
Reduce heat.
Add vegetable and saute a few minutes until tender.
Sprinkle lightly with onion salt.

title: Overnight Tossed Salad
