Recipe Ingredients: 1 sm. head iceberg lettuce, torn"1/2 c. finely chopped green pepper"1/2 c. finely chopped celery"1/4 c. thinly sliced red onion rings"4 oz. fresh mushrooms, cleaned and sliced"2 tsp. lemon juice
Body:
Layer first 5 ingredients in order give in salad bowl, tossing mushrooms with lemon juice before layering.
Refrigerate overnight.
Toss and serve with chicken, turkey, or fish.

title: Wilted Spinach Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. raw spinach"1/4 med. onion, thinly sliced"1/4 c. cider vinegar"1/2 tsp. (dry) prepared mustard"1/4 tsp. garlic salt"Stevia"pepper
Body:
Combine spinach and onion, separated into rings.
Cover and chill in refrigerator.
For dressing, add ingredients and heat the dressing until it starts to steam.
Pour hot dressing over salad tossing gently to wilt greens.

title: Perfection Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 2 tbsp. unflavored gelatin"1/2 c. cold water"2 c. boiling water"1/4 c. cider vinegar"1/4 c. lemon juice"1/4 c unsalted tomato juice"Stevia to substitute for 1/2 c. cugar"1 c. cabbage, shredded"1 c. celery, diced"3 tbsp. pimento, chopped"3 tbsp. green pepper, chopped
Body:
Dissolve unflavored gelatin in cold water.
Add boiling water, vinegar, lemon juice, tomato juice, and sugar substitute.
Cool until mixture begins to thicken.
Fold in chopped vegetables.
Pour into 1/2 cup molds and chill until ready to serve.

title: Tossed Garden Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1/4 head crisp iceberg lettuce or Boston lettuce"6 spinach leaves, used for color contrast"3 thin, shredded slices raddichio"2 slices celery, cut cross-wise"1/4 green pepper, sliced thinly"1 small tomato sliced into thin wedges"1 green onion, sliced (use both bulb and stem)"pinch of dill weed, chopped
Body: Place ingredients in salad bowl in order listed until just before serving. Toss.

title: Baby Spinach Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. baby spinach greens"3/4 tbsp. balsamic vinegar"1/2 tsp. Dijon mustard"1/2 tsp. orange zest"1/2 tbsp. orange juice (from squeezed orange)"1/2 tsp. freshly grated ginger"salt and pepper to taste"pinch of red pepper flakes
Body: Whisk ingredients together and toss with baby spinach or mixed baby greens.

title: Tangy Tossed Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 lg. head lettuce"1 green pepper"1 red onion"1 bundle celery"4 oz. radishes"1 medium cucumber
Body:
Chop lettuce and other vegetables.
Mix in salad bowl.
Chill and serve with Balsamic Vinaigrette Dressing (see recipe).

title: Tangy Tomato Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 1 c. chicken bouillon base"1 large tomato"1 clove minced garlic"1/2 tsp. onion salt"1/2 tsp. Stevia"1/2 tsp. basil"salt and pepper to taste
Body:
Saute garlic in 1 tbsp. bouillon base and set aside.
Puree tomatoes in blender and then cook over medium heat to a boil.
Turn heat to low.
Add remaining bouillon and spices.
Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Green Onion Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 10 green onions"2 c. vegetable broth"1 tsp. parsley"4 drops or 1 packet Stevia"1/2 tsp. paprika"1/2 tsp. salt"1/2 tsp. dill"1/2 tsp. thyme"pinch of cayenne or red pepper flakes"pinch of celery seed
Body:
Briefly steam the green onions until tender in a saucepan over medium heat.
Chop steamed green onions.
In a saucepan, saute the green onions in a small amount of vegetable broth for two minutes.
Add parsley, Stevia, paprika, salt, dill, thyme, celery seed, and cayenne.
Saute 1 to 2 minutes more.
Add remaining vegetable broth, reduce heat.
Simmer 20 to 30 minutes.

title: French Onion Soup
Recipe Ingredients: 1 Vidalia onion"1 c. beef broth"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. onion salt"1 tsp. pepper"2 pieces of Melba toast
Body:
Slice onion with an apple slicer to make wedges and to open the onion.
Season the onion and place it on top of a foil sheet.
Add 1/4 c. beef broth and wrap it up tightly.
Place in a baking dish and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.
Make sure the onion is not too soft; should be a little firm.
Serve in a bowl with beef broth and Melba toast.

title: Chicken Broth base
Recipe Ingredients: 6-4 oz. pieces of chicken"9 c. water"1 tsp. garlic powder"1 tsp. onion salt"1 tsp. celery salt"1 tsp. poultry seasoning"1 tsp. pepper"1 tbsp. sea salt
Body:
Combine ingredients in soup pot and cook until chicken is done, about 35 minutes.
Take chicken out and save for recipes.
Freeze some in ice cube trays for sauteing and vegetables.

title: Autumn Tossed Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1/2 head lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces"1 unpeeled tart apple, cored and sliced into wedges"1/2 small red onion, sliced into rings
Body: In large bowl, toss lettuce, apple slices, and onions.

title: Cucumber Apple Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 chopped apple"1 sliced cucumber"2 tbsp. apple cider vinegar"1 tbsp. water"garlic salt"pepper"Stevia
Body:
Chop apple and thinly slice cucumber.
Combine vinegar and water.
Season with garlic salt, pepper, and Stevia to taste.

title: Strawberry Sorbet
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"juice of 1 lemon"Stevia (sweeten to taste)
Body:
Freeze fresh strawberries for about 1 hour.
Blend fresh frozen strawberries, lemon juice, and sugar substitute in blender until very well blended.
Add water to thin desired consistency.
Serve immediately or place in freezer to all it to firm up even further.

title: No Flour Apple Cobbler
Recipe Ingredients: 1 apple, sliced"pinch of cinnamon"1 tsp. Stevia
Body:
Topping: 1 tsp. cinnamon
1 tsp. Stevia

Toss the above ingredients and arrange in oven safe dish.

title: Berry Smoothie
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. partially frozen strawberries or 1 med. orange"1 tsp. Stevia"5 drops Orange Stevia"5 drops Vanilla Cream Stevia
Body: Blend until smooth.

title: Baked Apple
Recipe Ingredients: 1 apple"1 tsp. Stevia"1 tbsp. cinnamon"1 tbsp. water"1 tsp. cinnamon
Body:
Cut apple core almost through.
Mix together Stevia and cinnamon with 1 tbsp. water.
Place apple on a sheet of foil and mold foil around the apple.
Pour Stevia and cinnamon mixture in the apple core.
Tighten foil securely around the apple.
Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.
Serve in a shallow dish and sprinkle cinnamon over the apple.

title: No Sugar Baked Apple
Recipe Ingredients: 1 apple, peeled"1/2 tsp. ground cinnamon"1 tsp. Stevia
Body:
Bake an apple and peel off skin. Mash.
Add cinnamon and Stevia.
Serve.

title: Spiced up Strawberries
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz. strawberries"1 tbsp. cinnamon"1 tsp. Stevia
Body:
Slice strawberries and place on a plate.
Mix cinnamon and Stevia. Sprinkle over strawberries.

title: Fruit Salad Dressing
Recipe Ingredients: 1 tbsp. vinegar (sherry, strawberry or raspberry is best)"1 tbsp. lemon juice"Stevia to taste"½ tsp. salt"pinch of freshly ground black pepper
Body:
Mix romaine, watercress (if used), strawberries and onion in salad bowl.
Mix dressing ingredients in a small jar with tightly fitting lid.
Shake well. Pour over greens and serve.

title: Romaine & Strawberry Salad
Recipe Ingredients: ½ head romaine lettuce"small bunch watercress stems removed (optional)"4 oz. strawberries, hulled and sliced"4 thinly sliced rings of red onion, separated

title: Jamaican Grapefruit
Recipe Ingredients: ½ grapefruit"cinnamon"1-2 tsp.Stevia
Body:
Cut grapefruit in half.
Place on an oven safe dish and bake for 2 minutesat 350°.
Cut around center core, rind and partitions.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and Stevia.

title: Apple & Balsamic Vinaigrette Salad
Recipe Ingredients: 1 head green leaf lettuce, roughly chopped"¼ c. finely chopped onion"1 apple, peeled and chopped into small cubes"1/2 Cup chopped parsley"2 Tbsp Balsamic Vinegar"2 Tbsp Soy Sauce
Body:
Combine vinegar and soy sauce in a small bowl and set aside.
Add remaining ingredients in a large bowl.
Add sauce to salad and toss.
Let sit for 5 minutes to marinate.

title: Blueberry Lavender Breeze
Recipe Ingredients: 4 oz blueberries"8 ice cubes"1 c cold water"1 pinch dried lavender"7 drops coconut stevia
Body: Combine all ingredients in blender
